      (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)) _ _
      (unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀) (unfoldHasReverse M.labeling e₀)
      (unfoldedMarkedGraphNew M e₀ ha))
proof:
:= by
  change Subgroup.closure (Set.range (@MarkedBinaryGraph.read n G H
    (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)) _ _
    (unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀) (unfoldHasReverse M.labeling e₀)
    (unfoldedMarkedGraphNew M e₀ ha))) = ⊤
  have hread :
      @MarkedBinaryGraph.read n G H (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)) _ _
        (unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀) (unfoldHasReverse M.labeling e₀)
        (unfoldedMarkedGraphNew M e₀ ha) = M.read := by
    funext i
    exact unfoldedMarkedGraphNew_read M e₀ ha i
  rw [hread]
  exact hgen

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.unfoldedMarkedGraphNew_weaklyConnected
statement:
theorem unfoldedMarkedGraphNew_weaklyConnected {n : ℕ}
    (M : MarkedBinaryGraph (G := G) (H := H) (V := V) n)
    (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = M.base)
    (hconn : M.WeaklyConnected) :
    (@MarkedBinaryGraph.WeaklyConnected n G H
      (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)) _ _
      (unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀) (unfoldHasReverse M.labeling e₀)
      (unfoldedMarkedGraphNew M e₀ ha))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Quiver (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)) :=
    unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀
  letI : HasInvolutiveReverse (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)) :=
    unfoldHasReverse M.labeling e₀
  intro z
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := unfoldedMarkedGraph_weaklyConnected M e₀ ha hconn z
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  exact (@Quiver.Symmetrify.of (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀))
      (unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀)).mapPath
      (unfoldSwitchNewOld M.labeling e₀) |>.comp p

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.unfoldNew_ne_sourceAt_color
statement:
theorem unfoldNew_ne_sourceAt_color
    (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G) (H := H) (V := V))
    (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V)) :
    unfoldNew (allArrowSource e₀) ≠
      unfoldVertexAt L (allArrowSource e₀) e₀
        (allArrowSource e₀) (unfoldEdgeColor L e₀)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hold :
      unfoldVertexAt L (allArrowSource e₀) e₀
          (allArrowSource e₀) (unfoldEdgeColor L e₀) =
        unfoldOld (allArrowSource e₀) :=
    (unfoldVertexAt_eq_old_iff L (allArrowSource e₀) e₀
      (allArrowSource e₀) (unfoldEdgeColor L e₀)).mpr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  exact unfoldNew_ne_old (allArrowSource e₀) (h.trans hold)

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.unfoldNew_ne_vertexAt_of_ne_source
statement:
theorem unfoldNew_ne_vertexAt_of_ne_source
    (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G) (H := H) (V := V))
    (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V)) {b : Symmetrify V}
    (hb : (show V from b) ≠ allArrowSource e₀) :
    unfoldNew (allArrowSource e₀) ≠
      unfoldVertexAt L (allArrowSource e₀) e₀
        (show V from b) (unfoldEdgeColor L e₀)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' : unfoldVertexAt L (allArrowSource e₀) e₀
        (show V from b) (unfoldEdgeColor L e₀) =
      unfoldNew (allArrowSource e₀) := h.symm
  exact hb ((unfoldVertexAt_eq_new_iff L (allArrowSource e₀) e₀
    (show V from b) (unfoldEdgeColor L e₀)).mp h').1

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.exists_safe_fold_after_unfold
statement:
theorem exists_safe_fold_after_unfold {n : ℕ}
    (M : MarkedBinaryGraph (G := G) (H := H) (V := V) n)
    (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = M.base)
    {b : Symmetrify V}
    (q : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V)
      (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V _) (show V from allArrowTarget e₀)
      b)
    (hb : (show V from b) ≠ allArrowSource e₀)
    (hq : M.labeling.symmIsMonochromatic q
      (unfoldEdgeColor M.labeling e₀))
    (hread : M.labeling.symmPathRead q =
      (separatedMap (allArrowLabel M.labeling e₀))⁻¹)
    (hgen : M.IsGenerating) (hconn : M.WeaklyConnected) :
    letI : Fintype (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)) :=
      unfoldVertexFintype (allArrowSource e₀)
    letI : Quiver (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)) :=
      unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀
    letI : HasInvolutiveReverse (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)) :=
      unfoldHasReverse M.labeling e₀
    letI (x y : UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)) : Fintype (x ⟶ y) :=
      unfoldQuiverHomFintype M.labeling e₀ x y
    ∃ e₁ : AllArrow,
      ∃ ha₁ : allArrowSource e₁ = unfoldNew (allArrowSource e₀),
        ∃ q₁ : @Quiver.Path
          (Symmetrify (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)))
          (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀))
            (unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀))
          ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀))
            (unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀)).obj (allArrowTarget e₁))
          ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀))
            (unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀)).obj
            (unfoldVertexAt M.labeling (allArrowSource e₀) e₀
              (show V from b) (unfoldEdgeColor M.labeling e₀))),
          ∃ hq₁ : foldSymmPathAvoid (qV := unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀)
              e₁ q₁,
            @MarkedBinaryGraph.IsGenerating n G H
                (foldVertex (unfoldNew (allArrowSource e₀))
                  (unfoldVertexAt M.labeling (allArrowSource e₀) e₀
                    (show V from b) (unfoldEdgeColor M.labeling e₀)))
                _ _ (foldQuiver e₁) (foldHasReverse e₁)
                (foldedMarkedGraphSymm
                  (unfoldedMarkedGraphNew M e₀ ha) e₁ ha₁ q₁ hq₁) ∧
            @MarkedBinaryGraph.WeaklyConnected n G H
                (foldVertex (unfoldNew (allArrowSource e₀))
                  (unfoldVertexAt M.labeling (allArrowSource e₀) e₀
                    (show V from b) (unfoldEdgeColor M.labeling e₀)))
                _ _ (foldQuiver e₁) (foldHasReverse e₁)
                (foldedMarkedGraphSymm
                  (unfoldedMarkedGraphNew M e₀ ha) e₁ ha₁ q₁ hq₁) ∧
            Fintype.card (foldVertex (unfoldNew (allArrowSource e₀))
              (unfoldVertexAt M.labeling (allArrowSource e₀) e₀
                (show V from b) (unfoldEdgeColor M.labeling e₀))) <
              Fintype.card (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)) :=
    unfoldVertexFintype (allArrowSource e₀)
  letI : Quiver (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)) :=
    unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀
  letI : HasInvolutiveReverse (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)) :=
    unfoldHasReverse M.labeling e₀
  letI (x y : UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)) : Fintype (x ⟶ y) :=
    unfoldQuiverHomFintype M.labeling e₀ x y
  let b₁ : UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀) :=
    unfoldVertexAt M.labeling (allArrowSource e₀) e₀
      (show V from b) (unfoldEdgeColor M.labeling e₀)
  let p₀ := unfoldDuplicateFoldPath M.labeling e₀ q hq
  let hp : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)))
      (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀))
        (unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀))
      (unfoldNew (allArrowSource e₀))
      ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀))
        (unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀)).obj b₁) := by
    exact p₀
  have hpread :
      (unfoldLabelling M.labeling e₀).symmPathRead hp = 1 := by
    dsimp [hp, p₀, b₁]
    exact (unfold_duplicate_safe_tail M.labeling e₀ q hq hread).2
  have hdecomp : ∃ c : Symmetrify (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)),
      ∃ e : @Quiver.Hom (Symmetrify (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)))
        (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀))
          (unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀))
        (show Symmetrify (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)) from
          unfoldNew (allArrowSource e₀)) c,
      ∃ q₁ : @Quiver.Path
        (Symmetrify (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)))
        (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀))
          (unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀)) c
        (show Symmetrify (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)) from b₁),
        hp = e.toPath.comp q₁ ∧ foldSymmPathAvoid (symmOrientedArrow e) q₁ := by
    let eD : @Quiver.Hom
        (Symmetrify (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)))
        (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀))
          (unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀))
        (unfoldNew (allArrowSource e₀))
        (unfoldVertexAt M.labeling (allArrowSource e₀) e₀
          (allArrowTarget e₀) (unfoldEdgeColor M.labeling e₀)) :=
      Sum.inl (unfoldDuplicateForward M.labeling e₀)
    let q₁ := (@Quiver.Symmetrify.of (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀))
      (unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀)).mapPath
      (unfoldSymmMonochromaticPath M.labeling e₀
        (unfoldEdgeColor M.labeling e₀) q hq)
    refine ⟨_, eD, q₁, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change unfoldDuplicateFoldPath M.labeling e₀ q hq =
        eD.toPath.comp q₁
      rfl
    · exact (unfold_duplicate_safe_tail M.labeling e₀ q hq hread).1
  have hgen' :
      (@MarkedBinaryGraph.IsGenerating n G H
        (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)) _ _
        (unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀) (unfoldHasReverse M.labeling e₀)
        (unfoldedMarkedGraphNew M e₀ ha)) :=
    unfoldedMarkedGraphNew_isGenerating M e₀ ha hgen
  have hconn' :
      (@MarkedBinaryGraph.WeaklyConnected n G H
        (UnfoldVertex (allArrowSource e₀)) _ _
        (unfoldQuiver M.labeling e₀) (unfoldHasReverse M.labeling e₀)
        (unfoldedMarkedGraphNew M e₀ ha)) :=
    unfoldedMarkedGraphNew_weaklyConnected M e₀ ha hconn
  obtain ⟨e₁, ha₁, q₁, hq₁, hgen₁, hconn₁, hcard₁⟩ :=
    exists_safe_folded_marked_graph
      (M := unfoldedMarkedGraphNew M e₀ ha)
      (a := unfoldNew (allArrowSource e₀)) (b := b₁)
      (unfoldNew_ne_vertexAt_of_ne_source M.labeling e₀ hb) hp hpread hdecomp
      hgen' hconn'
  exact ⟨e₁, ha₁, q₁, hq₁, hgen₁, hconn₁, hcard₁⟩

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.foldReverseFree
statement:
theorem foldReverseFree {a b : V} (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    (hfree : ReverseFree (V := V)) :
    letI : Fintype (foldVertex a b) := foldVertexFintype a b
    letI : Quiver (foldVertex a b) := foldQuiver e₀
    letI : HasInvolutiveReverse (foldVertex a b) := foldHasReverse e₀
    letI (x y : foldVertex a b) : Fintype (x ⟶ y) :=
      foldQuiverHomFintype e₀ x y
    ReverseFree (V := foldVertex a b)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype (foldVertex a b) := foldVertexFintype a b
  letI : Quiver (foldVertex a b) := foldQuiver e₀
  letI : HasInvolutiveReverse (foldVertex a b) := foldHasReverse e₀
  letI (x y : foldVertex a b) : Fintype (x ⟶ y) :=
    foldQuiverHomFintype e₀ x y
  exact fold_allArrow_reverse_ne e₀ hfree

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.edgeRepresentative_lt_reverse
statement:
theorem edgeRepresentative_lt_reverse
    (hfree : ReverseFree (V := V)) (e : EdgeRepresentative (V := V)) :
    (allArrowIndex e.1).val <
      (allArrowIndex (allArrowReverse e.1)).val

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.edgeRepresentativeOrientation_reverse
statement:
theorem edgeRepresentativeOrientation_reverse
    (e : EdgeRepresentative (V := V)) (b : Bool) :
    allArrowReverse (edgeRepresentativeOrientation e b) =
      edgeRepresentativeOrientation e (!b)
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> simp [edgeRepresentativeOrientation]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.edgeRepresentativeOrientation_injective
statement:
theorem edgeRepresentativeOrientation_injective
    (hfree : ReverseFree (V := V)) :
    Function.Injective
      (fun p : EdgeRepresentative (V := V) × Bool =>
        edgeRepresentativeOrientation p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  rcases p with ⟨p, bp⟩
  rcases q with ⟨q, bq⟩
  cases bp <;> cases bq
  · have h : p.1 = q.1 := hpq
    cases p
    cases q
    simp_all
  · exfalso
    have hlt₁ := edgeRepresentative_lt_reverse hfree p
    have hlt₂ := edgeRepresentative_lt_reverse hfree q
    change p.1 = allArrowReverse q.1 at hpq
    have hrev : allArrowReverse q.1 = p.1 := hpq.symm
    have hidx : (allArrowIndex q.1).val < (allArrowIndex p.1).val := by
      simpa only [hrev] using hlt₂
    have hrev' : allArrowReverse p.1 = q.1 := by
      simpa only [allArrowReverse_reverse] using
        (congrArg (allArrowReverse (V := V)) hrev).symm
    have hidx' : (allArrowIndex p.1).val < (allArrowIndex q.1).val := by
      simpa only [hrev'] using hlt₁
    omega
  · exfalso
    have hlt₁ := edgeRepresentative_lt_reverse hfree p
    have hlt₂ := edgeRepresentative_lt_reverse hfree q
    change allArrowReverse p.1 = q.1 at hpq
    have hrev : p.1 = allArrowReverse q.1 := by
      simpa only [allArrowReverse_reverse] using
        congrArg (allArrowReverse (V := V)) hpq
    have hidx : (allArrowIndex p.1).val < (allArrowIndex q.1).val := by
      simpa only [hpq] using hlt₁
    have hidx' : (allArrowIndex q.1).val < (allArrowIndex p.1).val := by
      simpa only [hrev] using hlt₂
    omega
  · have h : allArrowReverse p.1 = allArrowReverse q.1 := hpq
    have h' : p.1 = q.1 := allArrowReverse_injective h
    cases p
    cases q
    simp_all

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.edgeRepresentative_card_mul_two
statement:
theorem edgeRepresentative_card_mul_two
    (hfree : ReverseFree (V := V)) :
    Fintype.card (EdgeRepresentative (V := V)) * 2 =
      Fintype.card (AllArrow (V := V))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Fintype.card_prod] using
    (Fintype.card_congr (edgeRepresentativeOrientationEquiv hfree))

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.allArrowLabel_reverse
statement:
theorem allArrowLabel_reverse
    (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G) (H := H) (V := V))
    (e : AllArrow (V := V)) :
    allArrowLabel L (allArrowReverse e) =
      factorWordInv (allArrowLabel L e)
proof:
:= by
  change L.label (Quiver.reverse (allArrowHom e)) =
    factorWordInv (L.label (allArrowHom e))
  exact L.reverse_label (allArrowHom e)

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.edgeRepresentativeLabels_closure_eq_top_of_markedGraph
statement:
theorem edgeRepresentativeLabels_closure_eq_top_of_markedGraph {n : ℕ}
    (M : MarkedBinaryGraph (G := G) (H := H) (V := V) n)
    (hfree : ReverseFree (V := V)) (hgen : M.IsGenerating) :
    Subgroup.closure (Set.range (fun e : EdgeRepresentative (V := V) =>
      separatedMap (edgeRepresentativeLabel M.labeling e))) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let R : Subgroup (G ∗ H) := Subgroup.closure (Set.range
    (fun e : EdgeRepresentative (V := V) =>
      separatedMap (edgeRepresentativeLabel M.labeling e)))
  have hle : Subgroup.closure (Set.range (fun e : AllArrow (V := V) =>
      separatedMap (allArrowLabel M.labeling e))) ≤ R := by
    apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
    rintro z ⟨e, rfl⟩
    by_cases hlt : (allArrowIndex e).val <
        (allArrowIndex (allArrowReverse e)).val
    · exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨⟨e, hlt⟩, rfl⟩
    · let er : EdgeRepresentative (V := V) :=
        reverse_mem_edgeRepresentative hfree e hlt
      have hlabel : allArrowLabel M.labeling e =
          factorWordInv (edgeRepresentativeLabel M.labeling er) := by
        change allArrowLabel M.labeling e =
          factorWordInv (allArrowLabel M.labeling (allArrowReverse e))
        rw [allArrowLabel_reverse]
        simp
      change separatedMap (allArrowLabel M.labeling e) ∈ R
      rw [hlabel, separatedMap_factorWordInv]
      exact Subgroup.inv_mem R (Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨er, rfl⟩)
  apply top_unique
  intro z hz
  exact hle ((allArrowLabels_closure_eq_top_of_markedGraph M hgen) ▸ hz)

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.padSeparated_contains_original
statement:
theorem padSeparated_contains_original {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n)
    (s : Fin m → Sum G H) (i : Fin m) :
    padSeparated h s ⟨i.val, lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt h⟩ = s i
proof:
:= by
  simp [padSeparated]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.padSeparated_closure_eq_top
statement:
theorem padSeparated_closure_eq_top {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n)
    (s : Fin m → Sum G H)
    (hs : Subgroup.closure (Set.range (separatedMap ∘ s)) = ⊤) :
    Subgroup.closure (Set.range
      (separatedMap ∘ padSeparated h s)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro z hz
  have hle : Subgroup.closure (Set.range (separatedMap ∘ s)) ≤
      Subgroup.closure (Set.range (separatedMap ∘ padSeparated h s)) := by
    apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
    rintro y ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨⟨i.val, lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt h⟩, ?_⟩
    change separatedMap
      (padSeparated h s ⟨i.val, lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt h⟩) =
      separatedMap (s i)
    rw [padSeparated_contains_original]
  exact hle ((hs ▸ hz))

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.exists_separated_generators_of_edge_bound
statement:
theorem exists_separated_generators_of_edge_bound {n : ℕ}
    (M : MarkedBinaryGraph (G := G) (H := H) (V := V) n)
    (hfree : ReverseFree (V := V)) (hgen : M.IsGenerating)
    (hcard : Fintype.card (AllArrow (V := V)) ≤ 2 * n) :
    ∃ s : Fin n → Sum G H,
      Subgroup.closure (Set.range (separatedMap ∘ s)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let m := Fintype.card (EdgeRepresentative (V := V))
  have hcardm : m ≤ n := by
    have hpair := edgeRepresentative_card_mul_two hfree
    dsimp [m]
    omega
  let eS : EdgeRepresentative (V := V) ≃ Fin m :=
    Fintype.equivFin (EdgeRepresentative (V := V))
  let s₀ : Fin m → Sum G H := fun i =>
    edgeRepresentativeLabel M.labeling (eS.symm i)
  have hs₀ : Subgroup.closure (Set.range (separatedMap ∘ s₀)) = ⊤ := by
    have hrange : Set.range (separatedMap ∘ s₀) = Set.range
        (fun e : EdgeRepresentative (V := V) =>
          separatedMap (edgeRepresentativeLabel M.labeling e)) := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨eS.symm i, by rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨e, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨eS e, by simp [s₀]⟩
    rw [hrange]
    exact edgeRepresentativeLabels_closure_eq_top_of_markedGraph M hfree hgen
  refine ⟨padSeparated hcardm s₀, padSeparated_closure_eq_top hcardm s₀ hs₀⟩

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.exists_separated_generators_of_euler_bound
statement:
theorem exists_separated_generators_of_euler_bound {n : ℕ}
    (M : MarkedBinaryGraph (G := G) (H := H) (V := V) n)
    (hfree : ReverseFree (V := V)) (hgen : M.IsGenerating)
    (hVcard : Fintype.card V = 1)
    (hEuler : Fintype.card (AllArrow (V := V)) ≤
      2 * (n + Fintype.card V - 1)) :
    ∃ s : Fin n → Sum G H,
      Subgroup.closure (Set.range (separatedMap ∘ s)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_separated_generators_of_edge_bound M hfree hgen
  omega

name: MarshallHall.symPathHom_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symPathHom_nil {a : Symmetrify (IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G)} :
    symPathHom (Path.nil : Path a a) = 𝟙 (show G from a)
proof: := rfl

name: MarshallHall.forgetSubquiverPath_nil
statement:
@[simp] theorem forgetSubquiverPath_nil {V : Type u} [Quiver V]
    {P : WideSubquiver V} {a : P} :
    forgetSubquiverPath (Path.nil : @Path P P.quiver a a) = Path.nil
proof: := rfl

name: MarshallHall.forgetSubquiverPath_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem forgetSubquiverPath_cons {V : Type u} [Quiver V]
    {P : WideSubquiver V} {a b c : P}
    (p : @Path P P.quiver a b) (e : b ⟶ c) :
    forgetSubquiverPath (p.cons e) = (forgetSubquiverPath p).cons e.1
proof: := rfl

name: MarshallHall.symPathHom_forget_cast_apply
statement:
theorem symPathHom_forget_cast_apply
    {G : Type u} [Groupoid G] [IsFreeGroupoid G]
    {P : WideSubquiver (Symmetrify (IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G))}
    {a a' b b' : P} {R : Type u}
    (f : ∀ {x y : G}, (x ⟶ y) → R)
    (p : @Path P P.quiver a b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    f (symPathHom (G := G)
      (forgetSubquiverPath (P := P) (p.cast ha hb))) =
    f (symPathHom (G := G)
      (forgetSubquiverPath (P := P) p))
proof:
:= by
  cases ha
  cases hb
  rfl

name: MarshallHall.retractBasisElement_one
statement:
theorem retractBasisElement_one {X K : Type u} [Group K]
    (B : FreeGroupBasis X K) (Y : Set X) :
    retractBasisElement B Y (1 : K) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold retractBasisElement
  rw [B.repr.map_one, (basisRetraction Y).map_one, (subsetBasisHom B Y).map_one]
  rfl

name: MarshallHall.retractBasisElement_mul
statement:
theorem retractBasisElement_mul {X K : Type u} [Group K]
    (B : FreeGroupBasis X K) (Y : Set X) (z w : K) :
    retractBasisElement B Y (z * w) =
      retractBasisElement B Y z * retractBasisElement B Y w
proof:
:= by
  unfold retractBasisElement
  rw [B.repr.map_mul, (basisRetraction Y).map_mul,
    (subsetBasisHom B Y).map_mul]
  rfl

name: MarshallHall.retractBasisElement_inv
statement:
theorem retractBasisElement_inv {X K : Type u} [Group K]
    (B : FreeGroupBasis X K) (Y : Set X) (z : K) :
    retractBasisElement B Y z⁻¹ = (retractBasisElement B Y z)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply (eq_inv_iff_mul_eq_one).2
  rw [← retractBasisElement_mul]
  rw [inv_mul_cancel, retractBasisElement_one]

name: MarshallHall.loopOfHom_comp
statement:
theorem loopOfHom_comp {T : WideSubquiver (Symmetrify (IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G))}
    [Arborescence T] {a b c : G} (p : a ⟶ b) (q : b ⟶ c) :
    IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom T (p ≫ q) =
      IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom T q *
        IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom T p
proof:
:= by
  simp [IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom, Category.assoc]

name: MarshallHall.loopOfHom_inv
statement:
theorem loopOfHom_inv {T : WideSubquiver (Symmetrify (IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G))}
    [Arborescence T] {a b : G} (p : a ⟶ b) :
      IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom T (inv p) =
      (IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom T p)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply (eq_inv_iff_mul_eq_one).2
  simp [IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom, CategoryTheory.End.mul_def,
    Category.assoc]

name: MarshallHall.basis_retraction_loop_of_edge
statement:
theorem basis_retraction_loop_of_edge
    {T : WideSubquiver (Symmetrify (IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G))}
    [Arborescence T]
    (P : Set (Quiver.Total (IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G)))
    {a b : IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G} (e : a ⟶ b)
    (heP : ⟨a, b, e⟩ ∈ P) :
    retractBasisElement (spanningTreeBasis T) (basisSupport (T := T) P)
      (IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom T (IsFreeGroupoid.of e)) =
      IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom T (IsFreeGroupoid.of e)
proof:
:= by
  let B := spanningTreeBasis T
  let X := ((wideSubquiverEquivSetTotal (wideSubquiverSymmetrify T))ᶜ :
      Set (Quiver.Total (IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G)))
  let Y := basisSupport (T := T) P
  by_cases heT : e ∈ wideSubquiverSymmetrify T a b
  · rw [IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom_eq_id T e heT]
    exact retractBasisElement_one B Y
  · let x : X := ⟨⟨a, b, e⟩, by
      change ¬ e ∈ wideSubquiverSymmetrify T a b
      exact heT⟩
    have hxY : x ∈ Y := by
      change (⟨a, b, e⟩ : Quiver.Total (IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G)) ∈ P
      exact heP
    have hBx : B x = IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom T
        (IsFreeGroupoid.of e) := by
      exact spanningTreeBasis_apply T x
    have hrepr : B.repr (IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom T
        (IsFreeGroupoid.of e)) = FreeGroup.of x := by
      rw [← hBx]
      exact B.repr_apply_coe x
    calc
      retractBasisElement B Y (IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom T
          (IsFreeGroupoid.of e)) =
          subsetBasisHom B Y (FreeGroup.of ⟨x, hxY⟩) := by
            rw [retractBasisElement, hrepr,
              basisRetraction_apply_of_mem Y hxY]
      _ = (B x : End (show G from root T)) := by
        rw [subsetBasisHom_apply_of]
      _ = IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom T (IsFreeGroupoid.of e) := hBx

name: MarshallHall.basis_retraction_loop_of_path
statement:
theorem basis_retraction_loop_of_path
    {T : WideSubquiver (Symmetrify (IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G))}
    [Arborescence T]
    (P : Set (Quiver.Total (IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G)))
    {a : Symmetrify (IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G)}
    (p : @Path (Symmetrify (IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G))
      (symmetrifyQuiver (IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G))
      (show Symmetrify (IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G) from root T) a)
    (hp : ∀ {x y : IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G} (e : x ⟶ y),
      ⟨x, y, e⟩ ∈ P) :
    retractBasisElement (spanningTreeBasis T) (basisSupport (T := T) P)
        (IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom T (symPathHom p)) =
      IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom T (symPathHom p)
proof:
:= by
  let B := spanningTreeBasis T
  let Y := basisSupport (T := T) P
  induction p with
  | nil =>
      rw [symPathHom_nil]
      rw [IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom]
      simp only [Category.id_comp, IsIso.hom_inv_id]
      exact retractBasisElement_one B Y
  | cons p e ih =>
      cases e with
      | inl e =>
          rw [symPathHom.eq_def, loopOfHom_comp]
          simp only [Sum.recOn]
          rw [retractBasisElement_mul,
            basis_retraction_loop_of_edge P e (hp e), ih]
      | inr e =>
          rw [symPathHom.eq_def, loopOfHom_comp]
          simp only [Sum.recOn]
          rw [retractBasisElement_mul, loopOfHom_inv,
            retractBasisElement_inv,
            basis_retraction_loop_of_edge P e (hp e), ih]

name: MarshallHall.basis_retraction_loop_of_subquiver_path
statement:
theorem basis_retraction_loop_of_subquiver_path
    {T : WideSubquiver (Symmetrify (IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G))}
    [Arborescence T]
    (P : Set (Quiver.Total (IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G)))
    (Q : WideSubquiver (Symmetrify (IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G)))
    (hQ : ∀ {a b : Symmetrify (IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G)}
      (e : a ⟶ b), e ∈ Q a b → positiveEdgeOfSym e ∈ P)
    {a : Q} (p : @Path (WideSubquiver.toType
      (Symmetrify (IsFreeGroupoid.Generators G)) Q) Q.quiver
      (show Q from root T) a) :
    retractBasisElement (spanningTreeBasis T) (basisSupport (T := T) P)
        (IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom T
          (symPathHom (forgetSubquiverPath p))) =
      IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom T
        (symPathHom (forgetSubquiverPath p))
proof:
:= by
  let B := spanningTreeBasis T
  let Y := basisSupport (T := T) P
  induction p with
  | nil =>
      rw [forgetSubquiverPath_nil, symPathHom_nil]
      rw [IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom]
      simp only [Category.id_comp, IsIso.hom_inv_id]
      exact retractBasisElement_one B Y
  | cons p e ih =>
      rw [forgetSubquiverPath_cons]
      rw [symPathHom.eq_def, loopOfHom_comp]
      rcases e with ⟨e | e, heQ⟩
      · have heP : positiveEdgeOfSym (Sum.inl e) ∈ P :=
            hQ (Sum.inl e) heQ
        have heP' : ⟨_, _, e⟩ ∈ P := by
          simpa [positiveEdgeOfSym] using heP
        rw [retractBasisElement_mul,
          basis_retraction_loop_of_edge P e heP', ih]
      · have heP : positiveEdgeOfSym (Sum.inr e) ∈ P :=
            hQ (Sum.inr e) heQ
        have heP' : ⟨_, _, e⟩ ∈ P := by
          simpa [positiveEdgeOfSym] using heP
        rw [retractBasisElement_mul, loopOfHom_inv,
          retractBasisElement_inv,
          basis_retraction_loop_of_edge P e heP', ih]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.binarySumIndex_factorMul
statement:
@[simp] theorem binarySumIndex_factorMul (x y : Sum G H)
    (hxy : binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) x =
      binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) y) :
    binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) (factorMul x y) =
      binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) x
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | inl x =>
      cases y with
      | inl y => simp [factorMul]
      | inr y => cases hxy
  | inr x =>
      cases y with
      | inl y => cases hxy
      | inr y => simp [factorMul]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.separatedMap_factorMul
statement:
theorem separatedMap_factorMul (x y : Sum G H)
    (hxy : binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) x =
      binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) y) :
    separatedMap (factorMul x y) =
      separatedMap x * separatedMap y
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | inl x =>
      cases y with
      | inl y => simp [factorMul, separatedMap]
      | inr y => cases hxy
  | inr x =>
      cases y with
      | inl y => cases hxy
      | inr y => simp [factorMul, separatedMap]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.factorWordInv_factorMul
statement:
theorem factorWordInv_factorMul (x y : Sum G H)
    (hxy : binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) x =
      binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) y) :
    factorWordInv (factorMul x y) =
      factorMul (factorWordInv y) (factorWordInv x)
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | inl x =>
      cases y with
      | inl y => simp [factorMul, factorWordInv]
      | inr y => cases hxy
  | inr x =>
      cases y with
      | inl y => cases hxy
      | inr y => simp [factorMul, factorWordInv]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.factorMul_assoc
statement:
theorem factorMul_assoc (x y z : Sum G H)
    (hxy : binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) x =
      binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) y)
    (hyz : binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) y =
      binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) z)
    (hleft : binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) (factorMul x y) =
      binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) z)
    (hright : binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) x =
      binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) (factorMul y z)) :
    factorMul (factorMul x y) z =
      factorMul x (factorMul y z)
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | inl x =>
      cases y with
      | inl y =>
          cases z with
          | inl z => simp [factorMul, mul_assoc]
          | inr z => cases hyz
      | inr y => cases hxy
  | inr x =>
      cases y with
      | inl y => cases hxy
      | inr y =>
          cases z with
          | inl z => cases hyz
          | inr z => simp [factorMul, mul_assoc]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.factorMul_reverse_both
statement:
theorem factorMul_reverse_both (x y : Sum G H)
    (hxy : binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) x =
      binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) y) :
    factorMul (factorMul (factorWordInv x) (factorWordInv y)) x =
      factorWordInv (factorMul (factorMul (factorWordInv x) y) x)
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> cases y <;> simp_all [factorMul, factorWordInv, mul_assoc]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.factorMul_reverse_source
statement:
theorem factorMul_reverse_source (x y : Sum G H)
    (hxy : binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) x =
      binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) y) :
    factorMul (factorWordInv x) (factorWordInv y) =
      factorWordInv (factorMul y x)
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> cases y <;> simp_all [factorMul, factorWordInv, mul_assoc]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.factorMul_reverse_target
statement:
theorem factorMul_reverse_target (x y : Sum G H)
    (hxy : binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) x =
      binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) y) :
    factorMul (factorWordInv y) x =
      factorWordInv (factorMul (factorWordInv x) y)
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> cases y <;> simp_all [factorMul, factorWordInv, mul_assoc]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.removeEndpoint_eq_of_ne
proof:
:= by

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.removeEndpoint_eq_anchor
statement:
@[simp] theorem removeEndpoint_eq_anchor {v : V}

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.removeEdgeReverse_reverse
statement:
theorem removeEdgeReverse_reverse {v : V} (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = v) (hn : allArrowTarget e₀ ≠ v)
    (e : RemovedEdge (V := V) e₀) :
    removeEdgeReverse e₀ ha hn (removeEdgeReverse e₀ ha hn e) = e
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [removeEdgeReverse]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.removeReverseFree
statement:
theorem removeReverseFree {v : V} (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = v) (hn : allArrowTarget e₀ ≠ v)
    (hfree : ReverseFree (V := V)) :
    letI : Fintype (RemovedVertex v) := removedVertexFintype v
    letI : Quiver (RemovedVertex v) := removeQuiver e₀ ha hn
    letI : HasInvolutiveReverse (RemovedVertex v) :=
      removeHasReverse e₀ ha hn
    letI (x y : RemovedVertex v) :
        Fintype (@Quiver.Hom (RemovedVertex v)
          (removeQuiver e₀ ha hn) x y) :=
      removeQuiverHomFintype e₀ ha hn x y
    ReverseFree (V := RemovedVertex v)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype (RemovedVertex v) := removedVertexFintype v
  letI : Quiver (RemovedVertex v) := removeQuiver e₀ ha hn
  letI : HasInvolutiveReverse (RemovedVertex v) :=
    removeHasReverse e₀ ha hn
  letI (x y : RemovedVertex v) :
      Fintype (@Quiver.Hom (RemovedVertex v)
        (removeQuiver e₀ ha hn) x y) :=
    removeQuiverHomFintype e₀ ha hn x y
  intro e h
  apply hfree e.2.2.1.1
  have h' := congrArg
    (fun z : @AllArrow (RemovedVertex v) (removeQuiver e₀ ha hn) =>
      z.2.2.1.1) h
  change allArrowReverse (e.2.2.1.1) = e.2.2.1.1 at h'
  exact h'

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.removeAllArrow_card_eq_removedEdge_card
statement:
theorem removeAllArrow_card_eq_removedEdge_card {v : V}
    (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V)) (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = v)
    (hn : allArrowTarget e₀ ≠ v) :
    Fintype.card (@AllArrow (RemovedVertex v) (removeQuiver e₀ ha hn)) =
      Fintype.card (RemovedEdge (V := V) e₀)
proof:
:= by
  exact Fintype.card_congr (removeAllArrowEquivEdge e₀ ha hn)

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.removedVertex_card_add_one
statement:
theorem removedVertex_card_add_one (v : V) :
    Fintype.card (RemovedVertex v) + 1 = Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := Fintype.card_subtype_compl (α := V) (fun x : V => x = v)
  have hcard : Fintype.card (RemovedVertex v) = Fintype.card V - 1 := by
    simpa [RemovedVertex] using h
  have hpos : 1 ≤ Fintype.card V := by
    letI : Nonempty V := ⟨v⟩
    exact Fintype.card_pos
  omega

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.removeEdgeLabel_index
statement:
theorem removeEdgeLabel_index {v : V}
    (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G) (H := H) (V := V))
    (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V)) (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = v)
    (hn : allArrowTarget e₀ ≠ v) (color : Bool)
    (hmono : MonochromaticVertex L v color)
    (e : RemovedEdge (V := V) e₀) :
    binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H)
        (removeEdgeLabel L e₀ ha hn color hmono e) =
    binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) (allArrowLabel L e.1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let g₀ := allArrowLabel L e₀
  let l := allArrowLabel L e.1
  have hg : binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) g₀ = color := by
    exact hmono e₀ (Or.inl ha)
  by_cases hs : allArrowSource e.1 = v
  · have hl : binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) l = color :=
      hmono e.1 (Or.inl hs)
    by_cases ht : allArrowTarget e.1 = v
    · have hxy : binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H)
          (factorWordInv g₀) =
          binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) l := by
        rw [binarySumIndex_factorWordInv, hl, hg]
      simp [removeEdgeLabel, hs, ht, g₀, l, hg, hl, hxy]
    · have hxy : binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H)
          (factorWordInv g₀) =
          binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) l := by
        rw [binarySumIndex_factorWordInv, hl, hg]
      simp [removeEdgeLabel, hs, ht, g₀, l, hg, hl, hxy]
  · by_cases ht : allArrowTarget e.1 = v
    · have hl : binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) l = color :=
        hmono e.1 (Or.inr ht)
      simp [removeEdgeLabel, hs, ht, g₀, l, hg, hl]
    · simpa [removeEdgeLabel, hs, ht, g₀, l]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.removeEdgeLabel_eq_source_target
statement:
theorem removeEdgeLabel_eq_source_target {v : V}
    (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G) (H := H) (V := V))
    (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V)) (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = v)
    (hn : allArrowTarget e₀ ≠ v) (color : Bool)
    (hmono : MonochromaticVertex L v color)
    (e : RemovedEdge (V := V) e₀)
    (hs : allArrowSource e.1 = v) (ht : allArrowTarget e.1 = v) :
    removeEdgeLabel L e₀ ha hn color hmono e =
      factorMul (factorMul (factorWordInv (allArrowLabel L e₀))
        (allArrowLabel L e.1)) (allArrowLabel L e₀)
proof:
:= by
  simp [removeEdgeLabel, hs, ht]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.removeEdgeLabel_eq_source_only
statement:
theorem removeEdgeLabel_eq_source_only {v : V}
    (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G) (H := H) (V := V))
    (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V)) (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = v)
    (hn : allArrowTarget e₀ ≠ v) (color : Bool)
    (hmono : MonochromaticVertex L v color)
    (e : RemovedEdge (V := V) e₀)
    (hs : allArrowSource e.1 = v) (ht : allArrowTarget e.1 ≠ v) :
    removeEdgeLabel L e₀ ha hn color hmono e =
      factorMul (factorWordInv (allArrowLabel L e₀))
        (allArrowLabel L e.1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [removeEdgeLabel, hs, ht]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.removeEdgeLabel_eq_target_only
statement:
theorem removeEdgeLabel_eq_target_only {v : V}
    (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G) (H := H) (V := V))
    (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V)) (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = v)
    (hn : allArrowTarget e₀ ≠ v) (color : Bool)
    (hmono : MonochromaticVertex L v color)
    (e : RemovedEdge (V := V) e₀)
    (hs : allArrowSource e.1 ≠ v) (ht : allArrowTarget e.1 = v) :
    removeEdgeLabel L e₀ ha hn color hmono e =
      factorMul (allArrowLabel L e.1) (allArrowLabel L e₀)
proof:
:= by

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.removeEdgeLabel_eq_neither
statement:
theorem removeEdgeLabel_eq_neither {v : V}
    (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G) (H := H) (V := V))
    (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V)) (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = v)
    (hn : allArrowTarget e₀ ≠ v) (color : Bool)
    (hmono : MonochromaticVertex L v color)
    (e : RemovedEdge (V := V) e₀)
    (hs : allArrowSource e.1 ≠ v) (ht : allArrowTarget e.1 ≠ v) :
    removeEdgeLabel L e₀ ha hn color hmono e = allArrowLabel L e.1
proof:
:= by
  simp [removeEdgeLabel, hs, ht]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.removeEdgeLabel_reverse
statement:
theorem removeEdgeLabel_reverse {v : V}
    (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G) (H := H) (V := V))
    (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V)) (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = v)
    (hn : allArrowTarget e₀ ≠ v) (color : Bool)
    (hmono : MonochromaticVertex L v color)
    (e : RemovedEdge (V := V) e₀) :
    removeEdgeLabel L e₀ ha hn color hmono
        (removeEdgeReverse e₀ ha hn e) =
      factorWordInv (removeEdgeLabel L e₀ ha hn color hmono e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let g₀ := allArrowLabel L e₀
  let l := allArrowLabel L e.1
  have hg : binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) g₀ = color := by
    exact hmono e₀ (Or.inl ha)
  have hlabelr : allArrowLabel L (allArrowReverse e.1) =
      factorWordInv (allArrowLabel L e.1) := by
    change L.label (Quiver.reverse (allArrowHom e.1)) =
      factorWordInv (L.label (allArrowHom e.1))
    exact L.reverse_label (allArrowHom e.1)
  by_cases hs : allArrowSource e.1 = v
  · have hl : binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) l = color :=
      hmono e.1 (Or.inl hs)
    by_cases ht : allArrowTarget e.1 = v
    · have hs' : allArrowSource (removeEdgeReverse e₀ ha hn e).1 = v := by
        simpa [removeEdgeReverse, allArrowSource_reverse] using ht
      have ht' : allArrowTarget (removeEdgeReverse e₀ ha hn e).1 = v := by
        simpa [removeEdgeReverse, allArrowTarget_reverse] using hs
      rw [removeEdgeLabel_eq_source_target L e₀ ha hn color hmono
        (removeEdgeReverse e₀ ha hn e) hs' ht']
      rw [removeEdgeLabel_eq_source_target L e₀ ha hn color hmono e hs ht]
      change factorMul (factorMul (factorWordInv g₀)
          (allArrowLabel L (allArrowReverse e.1))) g₀ =
        factorWordInv (factorMul (factorMul (factorWordInv g₀) l) g₀)
      rw [hlabelr]
      apply factorMul_reverse_both
      rw [hg, hl]
    · have hs' : allArrowSource (removeEdgeReverse e₀ ha hn e).1 ≠ v := by
        simpa [removeEdgeReverse, allArrowSource_reverse] using ht
      have ht' : allArrowTarget (removeEdgeReverse e₀ ha hn e).1 = v := by
        simpa [removeEdgeReverse, allArrowTarget_reverse] using hs
      rw [removeEdgeLabel_eq_target_only L e₀ ha hn color hmono
        (removeEdgeReverse e₀ ha hn e) hs' ht']
      rw [removeEdgeLabel_eq_source_only L e₀ ha hn color hmono e hs ht]
      change factorMul (allArrowLabel L (allArrowReverse e.1)) g₀ =
        factorWordInv (factorMul (factorWordInv g₀) l)
      rw [hlabelr]
      apply factorMul_reverse_target
      rw [hg, hl]
  · by_cases ht : allArrowTarget e.1 = v
    · have hl : binarySumIndex (G := G) (H := H) l = color :=
        hmono e.1 (Or.inr ht)
      have hs' : allArrowSource (removeEdgeReverse e₀ ha hn e).1 = v := by
        simpa [removeEdgeReverse, allArrowSource_reverse] using ht
      have ht' : allArrowTarget (removeEdgeReverse e₀ ha hn e).1 ≠ v := by
        simpa [removeEdgeReverse, allArrowTarget_reverse] using hs
      rw [removeEdgeLabel_eq_source_only L e₀ ha hn color hmono
        (removeEdgeReverse e₀ ha hn e) hs' ht']
      rw [removeEdgeLabel_eq_target_only L e₀ ha hn color hmono e hs ht]
      change factorMul (factorWordInv g₀)
          (allArrowLabel L (allArrowReverse e.1)) =
        factorWordInv (factorMul l g₀)
      rw [hlabelr]
      apply factorMul_reverse_source
      rw [hg, hl]
    · have hs' : allArrowSource (removeEdgeReverse e₀ ha hn e).1 ≠ v := by
        simpa [removeEdgeReverse, allArrowSource_reverse] using ht
      have ht' : allArrowTarget (removeEdgeReverse e₀ ha hn e).1 ≠ v := by
        simpa [removeEdgeReverse, allArrowTarget_reverse] using hs
      rw [removeEdgeLabel_eq_neither L e₀ ha hn color hmono
        (removeEdgeReverse e₀ ha hn e) hs' ht']
      rw [removeEdgeLabel_eq_neither L e₀ ha hn color hmono e hs ht]
      change allArrowLabel L (allArrowReverse e.1) = factorWordInv l
      exact hlabelr

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.removeEdgePath_of_retained
statement:
theorem removeEdgePath_of_retained {v : V} (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = v) (hn : allArrowTarget e₀ ≠ v)
    {x y : V} (e : x ⟶ y)
    (he₀ : allArrowOf e ≠ e₀)
    (her : allArrowOf e ≠ allArrowReverse e₀) :
    removeEdgePath e₀ ha hn e =
      @Quiver.Hom.toPath (RemovedVertex v) (removeQuiver e₀ ha hn)
        _ _ (removeEdgeOf e₀ ha hn e he₀ her)
proof:
:= by
  simp [removeEdgePath, he₀, her]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.removePath_nil
statement:
@[simp] theorem removePath_nil {v : V} (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = v) (hn : allArrowTarget e₀ ≠ v)
    {x : V} :
    removePath e₀ ha hn (@Quiver.Path.nil V qV x) =
      @Quiver.Path.nil (RemovedVertex v) (removeQuiver e₀ ha hn) _
proof:
:=
  by simp only [removePath]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.removePath_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem removePath_cons {v : V} (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = v) (hn : allArrowTarget e₀ ≠ v)
    {x y z : V} (p : @Quiver.Path V qV x y) (e : y ⟶ z) :
    removePath e₀ ha hn (Path.cons p e) =
      @Quiver.Path.comp (RemovedVertex v) (removeQuiver e₀ ha hn) _ _ _
        (removePath e₀ ha hn p) (removeEdgePath e₀ ha hn e)
proof:
:=
  by simp only [removePath]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.removePotential_eq_vertex
statement:
@[simp] theorem removePotential_eq_vertex {v : V}
    (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G) (H := H) (V := V))
    (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V)) (color : Bool) :
    removePotential (v := v) L e₀ color v = separatedMap (allArrowLabel L e₀)
proof:
:= by

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.removePotential_eq_one_of_ne
statement:
@[simp] theorem removePotential_eq_one_of_ne {v : V}
    (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G) (H := H) (V := V))
    (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V)) (color : Bool) {x : V} (hx : x ≠ v) :

proof:
:= by
