name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.symmAllArrow_eq_oriented_or_reverse
statement:
theorem symmAllArrow_eq_oriented_or_reverse {x y : Symmetrify V}
    (e : @Quiver.Hom (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) x y) :
    symmAllArrow e = symmOrientedArrow e ∨
      symmAllArrow e = allArrowReverse (symmOrientedArrow e)
proof:
:= by
  cases e with
  | inl f => exact Or.inl rfl
  | inr f =>
      right
      change allArrowOf f =
        allArrowReverse (allArrowReverse (allArrowOf f))
      rw [allArrowReverse_reverse]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.symmLabel_eq_allArrowLabel_oriented
statement:
theorem symmLabel_eq_allArrowLabel_oriented
    (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G) (H := H) (V := V))
    {x y : Symmetrify V}
    (e : @Quiver.Hom (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) x y) :
    L.symmLabel e = allArrowLabel L (symmOrientedArrow e)
proof:
:= by
  cases e with
  | inl f => rfl
  | inr f =>
      change factorWordInv (L.label f) = L.label (Quiver.reverse f)
      rw [L.reverse_label]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.symmPathEdges_nil

@[simp] theorem symmPathEdges_nil {a : Symmetrify V} :

proof:
:= by

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.symmPathEdges_comp
proof:
| _, Path.nil => by simp
  | _, Path.cons q e => by
      simp only [Path.comp_cons, symmPathEdges]
      rw [symmPathEdges_comp p q, List.append_assoc]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.foldSymmPathAvoid_of_geometricallySimple
statement:
theorem foldSymmPathAvoid_of_geometricallySimple
    {a c b : Symmetrify V}
    (e : @Quiver.Hom (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) a c)
    (q : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) c b)
    (hsimple : GeometricallySimple (qV := qV) (e.toPath.comp q)) :
    foldSymmPathAvoid (symmOrientedArrow e) q
proof:
:= by
  let e₀ := symmOrientedArrow e
  have hsimple' : List.Pairwise (fun x y : AllArrow (V := V) =>
      x ≠ y ∧ x ≠ allArrowReverse y)
      (symmAllArrow e :: symmPathEdges (qV := qV) q) := by
    change List.Pairwise (fun x y : AllArrow (V := V) =>
      x ≠ y ∧ x ≠ allArrowReverse y)
      (symmPathEdges (qV := qV) (e.toPath.comp q)) at hsimple
    rw [symmPathEdges_comp, symmPathEdges_toPath] at hsimple
    simpa using hsimple
  have hfirst : ∀ z ∈ symmPathEdges (qV := qV) q,
      symmAllArrow e ≠ z ∧ symmAllArrow e ≠ allArrowReverse z := by
    intro z hz
    exact (List.pairwise_cons.mp hsimple').1 z hz
  have hfirst' : ∀ z ∈ symmPathEdges (qV := qV) q,
      z ≠ e₀ ∧ z ≠ allArrowReverse e₀ := by
    intro z hz
    change z ≠ symmOrientedArrow e ∧
      z ≠ allArrowReverse (symmOrientedArrow e)
    have h := hfirst z hz
    have hor := symmAllArrow_eq_oriented_or_reverse (qV := qV) e
    constructor
    · intro hz₀
      rcases hor with hor | hor
      · exact h.1 (hor.trans hz₀.symm)
      · exact h.2 (hor.trans (congrArg (allArrowReverse (V := V)) hz₀).symm)
    · intro hz₀
      rcases hor with hor | hor
      · apply h.2
        calc
          symmAllArrow e = symmOrientedArrow e := hor
          _ = allArrowReverse (allArrowReverse (symmOrientedArrow e)) :=
            (allArrowReverse_reverse (symmOrientedArrow e)).symm
          _ = allArrowReverse z := by rw [hz₀]
      · apply h.1
        exact hor.trans hz₀.symm
  have havoid_aux : ∀ {x y : Symmetrify V}
      (p : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) x y),
      (∀ z ∈ symmPathEdges (qV := qV) p,
        z ≠ e₀ ∧ z ≠ allArrowReverse e₀) →
      foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ p := by
    intro x y p
    induction p with
    | nil =>
        intro _
        simp [foldSymmPathAvoid]
    | cons p f ih =>
        intro hp
        have htail : ∀ z ∈ symmPathEdges (qV := qV) p,
            z ≠ e₀ ∧ z ≠ allArrowReverse e₀ := by
          intro z hz
          apply hp z
          simp [symmPathEdges, hz]
        have hf : symmAllArrow f ≠ e₀ ∧
            symmAllArrow f ≠ allArrowReverse e₀ := by
          apply hp
          simp [symmPathEdges]
        simpa [foldSymmPathAvoid] using ⟨ih htail, hf.1, hf.2⟩
  apply havoid_aux q
  intro z hz
  exact hfirst' z hz

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.foldSymmPathAvoid_cast
statement:
theorem foldSymmPathAvoid_cast {e₀ : AllArrow (V := V)}
    {x y x' y' : Symmetrify V} (hx : x = x') (hy : y = y')
    (p : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) x y) :
    foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ (p.cast hx hy) ↔ foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ p
proof:
:= by
  subst_vars
  rfl

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.foldSymmPathAvoid_comp
statement:
theorem foldSymmPathAvoid_comp (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    {x y z : Symmetrify V}
    (p : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) x y)
    (q : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) y z) :
    foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ (p.comp q) ↔
      foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ p ∧ foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ q
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | nil =>
      rw [Path.comp_nil]
      constructor
      · intro hp
        exact ⟨hp, by simp [foldSymmPathAvoid]⟩
      · rintro ⟨hp, _⟩
        exact hp
  | cons q e ih =>
      simp only [Path.comp_cons, foldSymmPathAvoid, ih, and_assoc]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.foldSymmPathAvoid_reverse
statement:
theorem foldSymmPathAvoid_reverse (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    {x y : Symmetrify V}
    (p : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) x y)
    (hp : foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ p) :
    foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ p.reverse
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons p e ih =>
      rw [Path.reverse, foldSymmPathAvoid_comp]
      have hp' : foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ p ∧ symmAllArrow e ≠ e₀ ∧
          symmAllArrow e ≠ allArrowReverse e₀ := by
        simpa [foldSymmPathAvoid] using hp
      refine ⟨?_, ih hp'.1⟩
      simpa only [Quiver.Hom.toPath, foldSymmPathAvoid,
        symmAllArrow_reverse] using
        (show True ∧ symmAllArrow e ≠ e₀ ∧
            symmAllArrow e ≠ allArrowReverse e₀ from
          ⟨True.intro, hp'.2.1, hp'.2.2⟩)

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.foldSymmOrdinaryArrowPath_read
statement:
theorem foldSymmOrdinaryArrowPath_read {a b : V}
    (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G) (H := H) (V := V))
    (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    {x y : Symmetrify V}
    (e : @Quiver.Hom (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) x y)
    (he₀ : symmAllArrow e ≠ e₀)
    (her : symmAllArrow e ≠ allArrowReverse e₀) :
    (@BinaryLabelling.pathRead G H (foldVertex a b)
      _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
      (foldLabelling L e₀) _ _
      (foldSymmOrdinaryArrowPath e₀ e he₀ her)) =
      separatedMap (L.symmLabel e)
proof:
:= by
  cases e with
  | inl f =>
      simp only [foldSymmOrdinaryArrowPath, BinaryLabelling.pathRead_toPath]
      change separatedMap (L.label f) =
        separatedMap (L.label f)
      rfl
  | inr f =>
      simp only [foldSymmOrdinaryArrowPath, BinaryLabelling.pathRead_reverse,
        BinaryLabelling.pathRead_toPath]
      change (separatedMap (L.label f))⁻¹ =
        separatedMap (factorWordInv (L.label f))
      rw [← separatedMap_factorWordInv]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.foldSymmOrdinaryPath_read
statement:
theorem foldSymmOrdinaryPath_read {a b : V}
    (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G) (H := H) (V := V))
    (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    {x y : Symmetrify V}
    (p : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) x y)
    (hp : foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ p) :
    (@BinaryLabelling.pathRead G H (foldVertex a b)
      _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
      (foldLabelling L e₀) _ _
      (foldSymmOrdinaryPath e₀ p hp)) =
      L.symmPathRead p
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
      simp only [foldSymmOrdinaryPath.eq_def,
        BinaryLabelling.pathRead_nil, BinaryLabelling.symmPathRead_nil]
  | cons p e ih =>
      have hp' : foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ p ∧ symmAllArrow e ≠ e₀ ∧
          symmAllArrow e ≠ allArrowReverse e₀ := by
        simpa [foldSymmPathAvoid] using hp
      calc
        (@BinaryLabelling.pathRead G H (foldVertex a b)
          _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
          (foldLabelling L e₀) _ _
          (foldSymmOrdinaryPath e₀ (p.cons e) hp)) =
            (@BinaryLabelling.pathRead G H (foldVertex a b)
              _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
              (foldLabelling L e₀) _ _
              (foldSymmOrdinaryPath e₀ p hp'.1)) *
              (@BinaryLabelling.pathRead G H (foldVertex a b)
                _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
                (foldLabelling L e₀) _ _
                (foldSymmOrdinaryArrowPath e₀ e hp'.2.1 hp'.2.2)) := by
          rw [foldSymmOrdinaryPath]
          exact @BinaryLabelling.pathRead_comp G H (foldVertex a b)
            _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀) (foldLabelling L e₀)
            _ _ (foldSymmOrdinaryPath e₀ p hp'.1) _
              (foldSymmOrdinaryArrowPath e₀ e hp'.2.1 hp'.2.2)
        _ = L.symmPathRead p * L.symmPathRead e.toPath := by
          rw [ih hp'.1,
            foldSymmOrdinaryArrowPath_read L e₀ e hp'.2.1 hp'.2.2,
            L.symmPathRead_toPath]
        _ = L.symmPathRead (p.cons e) := by
          rw [← Path.comp_toPath_eq_cons, L.symmPathRead_comp,
            L.symmPathRead_toPath]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.foldSymmEdgePath_read
statement:
theorem foldSymmEdgePath_read {a b : V}
    (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G) (H := H) (V := V))
    (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = a)
    {x y : Symmetrify V}
    (e : @Quiver.Hom (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) x y)
    (q : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV)
      ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of V qV).obj (allArrowTarget e₀))
      ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of V qV).obj b))
    (hq : foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ q)
    (hread : L.symmPathRead q =
      (separatedMap (allArrowLabel L e₀))⁻¹) :
    (@BinaryLabelling.pathRead G H (foldVertex a b)
      _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
      (foldLabelling L e₀) _ _
      (foldSymmEdgePath e₀ ha e q hq)) =
      separatedMap (L.symmLabel e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases e with
  | inl f =>
      by_cases h : allArrowOf f = e₀
      · simp only [foldSymmEdgePath, dif_pos h,
          BinaryLabelling.pathRead_cast]
        have hordinary := foldSymmOrdinaryPath_read (a := a) (b := b)
          L e₀ q.reverse (foldSymmPathAvoid_reverse e₀ q hq)
        have hlabel : L.label f = allArrowLabel L e₀ := by
          calc
            L.label f = allArrowLabel L (allArrowOf f) := by rfl
            _ = allArrowLabel L e₀ := congrArg (allArrowLabel L) h
        calc
          _ = L.symmPathRead q.reverse := hordinary
          _ = separatedMap (allArrowLabel L e₀) := by
            rw [L.symmPathRead_reverse, hread, inv_inv]
          _ = separatedMap (L.label f) := by rw [hlabel]
          _ = separatedMap (L.symmLabel (Sum.inl f)) := by rfl
      · by_cases h' : allArrowOf f = allArrowReverse e₀
        · simp only [foldSymmEdgePath, dif_neg h, dif_pos h',
            BinaryLabelling.pathRead_cast]
          have hordinary := foldSymmOrdinaryPath_read (a := a) (b := b)
            L e₀ q hq
          have hlabel : L.label f =
              factorWordInv (allArrowLabel L e₀) := by
            calc
              L.label f = allArrowLabel L (allArrowOf f) := by rfl
              _ = allArrowLabel L (allArrowReverse e₀) :=
                congrArg (allArrowLabel L) h'
              _ = factorWordInv (allArrowLabel L e₀) := by
                change L.label (Quiver.reverse (allArrowHom e₀)) =
                  factorWordInv (L.label (allArrowHom e₀))
                exact L.reverse_label (allArrowHom e₀)
          calc
            _ = L.symmPathRead q := hordinary
            _ = (separatedMap (allArrowLabel L e₀))⁻¹ := hread
            _ = separatedMap (factorWordInv (allArrowLabel L e₀)) := by
              rw [separatedMap_factorWordInv]
            _ = separatedMap (L.label f) := by rw [hlabel]
            _ = separatedMap (L.symmLabel (Sum.inl f)) := by rfl
        · simpa only [foldSymmEdgePath, dif_neg h, dif_neg h'] using
            (foldSymmOrdinaryArrowPath_read L e₀ (Sum.inl f) h h')
  | inr f =>
      by_cases h : allArrowOf f = e₀
      · simp only [foldSymmEdgePath, dif_pos h,
          BinaryLabelling.pathRead_cast]
        have hordinary := foldSymmOrdinaryPath_read (a := a) (b := b)
          L e₀ q hq
        have hlabel : L.label f = allArrowLabel L e₀ := by
          calc
            L.label f = allArrowLabel L (allArrowOf f) := by rfl
            _ = allArrowLabel L e₀ := congrArg (allArrowLabel L) h
        calc
          _ = L.symmPathRead q := hordinary
          _ = (separatedMap (allArrowLabel L e₀))⁻¹ := hread
          _ = separatedMap (factorWordInv (allArrowLabel L e₀)) := by
            rw [separatedMap_factorWordInv]
          _ = separatedMap (factorWordInv (L.label f)) := by rw [hlabel]
          _ = separatedMap (L.symmLabel (Sum.inr f)) := by rfl
      · by_cases h' : allArrowOf f = allArrowReverse e₀
        · simp only [foldSymmEdgePath, dif_neg h, dif_pos h',
            BinaryLabelling.pathRead_cast]
          have hordinary := foldSymmOrdinaryPath_read (a := a) (b := b)
            L e₀ q.reverse (foldSymmPathAvoid_reverse e₀ q hq)
          have hlabel : L.label f =
              factorWordInv (allArrowLabel L e₀) := by
            calc
              L.label f = allArrowLabel L (allArrowOf f) := by rfl
              _ = allArrowLabel L (allArrowReverse e₀) :=
                congrArg (allArrowLabel L) h'
              _ = factorWordInv (allArrowLabel L e₀) := by
                change L.label (Quiver.reverse (allArrowHom e₀)) =
                  factorWordInv (L.label (allArrowHom e₀))
                exact L.reverse_label (allArrowHom e₀)
          calc
            _ = L.symmPathRead q.reverse := hordinary
            _ = separatedMap (allArrowLabel L e₀) := by
              rw [L.symmPathRead_reverse, hread, inv_inv]
            _ = separatedMap (factorWordInv (L.label f)) := by
              rw [hlabel]
              simp
            _ = separatedMap (L.symmLabel (Sum.inr f)) := by rfl
        · simpa only [foldSymmEdgePath, dif_neg h, dif_neg h'] using
            (foldSymmOrdinaryArrowPath_read L e₀ (Sum.inr f) h h')

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.foldSymmMapPath_read
statement:
theorem foldSymmMapPath_read {a b : V}
    (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G) (H := H) (V := V))
    (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = a)
    (q : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV)
      ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of V qV).obj (allArrowTarget e₀))
      ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of V qV).obj b))
    (hq : foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ q)
    (hread : L.symmPathRead q =
      (separatedMap (allArrowLabel L e₀))⁻¹) :
    ∀ {x y : Symmetrify V}
      (p : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) x y),
      (@BinaryLabelling.pathRead G H (foldVertex a b)
        _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
        (foldLabelling L e₀) _ _
        (foldSymmMapPath e₀ ha q hq p)) = L.symmPathRead p
proof:
:= by
  intro x y p
  induction p with
  | nil =>
      simp only [foldSymmMapPath, BinaryLabelling.pathRead_nil,
        BinaryLabelling.symmPathRead_nil]
  | cons p e ih =>
      calc
        (@BinaryLabelling.pathRead G H (foldVertex a b)
          _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
          (foldLabelling L e₀) _ _
          (foldSymmMapPath e₀ ha q hq (p.cons e))) =
            (@BinaryLabelling.pathRead G H (foldVertex a b)
              _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
              (foldLabelling L e₀) _ _
              (foldSymmMapPath e₀ ha q hq p)) *
              (@BinaryLabelling.pathRead G H (foldVertex a b)
                _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
                (foldLabelling L e₀) _ _
                (foldSymmEdgePath e₀ ha e q hq)) := by
          rw [foldSymmMapPath]
          exact @BinaryLabelling.pathRead_comp G H (foldVertex a b)
            _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀) (foldLabelling L e₀)
            _ _ (foldSymmMapPath e₀ ha q hq p) _
              (foldSymmEdgePath e₀ ha e q hq)
        _ = L.symmPathRead p * L.symmPathRead e.toPath := by
          rw [ih, foldSymmEdgePath_read L e₀ ha e q hq hread,
            L.symmPathRead_toPath]
        _ = L.symmPathRead (p.cons e) := by
          rw [← Path.comp_toPath_eq_cons, L.symmPathRead_comp,
            L.symmPathRead_toPath]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.foldEdgePath_read
statement:
theorem foldEdgePath_read {a b : V} (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G)
    (H := H) (V := V)) (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = a) {x y : V} (e : x ⟶ y)
    (q : @Quiver.Path V _ (allArrowTarget e₀) b)
    (hq : foldPathAvoid e₀ q)
    (hread : L.pathRead q =
      (separatedMap (allArrowLabel L e₀))⁻¹) :
    (@BinaryLabelling.pathRead G H (foldVertex a b)
      _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
      (foldLabelling L e₀)
      _ _
      (foldEdgePath e₀ ha e q hq)) = L.pathRead e.toPath
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : allArrowOf e = e₀
  · simp only [foldEdgePath, dif_pos h, BinaryLabelling.pathRead_cast]
    rw [foldOrdinaryPath_read L e₀ q.reverse (foldPathAvoid_reverse e₀ q hq)]
    rw [BinaryLabelling.pathRead_reverse L q, hread, inv_inv]
    rw [L.pathRead_toPath]
    have hlabel : L.label e = allArrowLabel L e₀ := by
      calc
        L.label e = allArrowLabel L (allArrowOf e) := by rfl
        _ = allArrowLabel L e₀ := congrArg (allArrowLabel L) h
    exact congrArg separatedMap hlabel.symm
  · by_cases h' : allArrowOf e = allArrowReverse e₀
    · simp only [foldEdgePath, dif_neg h, dif_pos h',
        BinaryLabelling.pathRead_cast]
      rw [foldOrdinaryPath_read L e₀ q hq, hread]
      rw [L.pathRead_toPath]
      have hlabel : L.label e = factorWordInv (allArrowLabel L e₀) := by
        calc
          L.label e = allArrowLabel L (allArrowOf e) := by rfl
          _ = allArrowLabel L (allArrowReverse e₀) := congrArg (allArrowLabel L) h'
          _ = factorWordInv (allArrowLabel L e₀) := by
            change L.label (Quiver.reverse (allArrowHom e₀)) =
              factorWordInv (L.label (allArrowHom e₀))
            exact L.reverse_label (allArrowHom e₀)
      rw [hlabel, separatedMap_factorWordInv]
    · simp only [foldEdgePath, dif_neg h, dif_neg h']
      rfl

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.foldMapPath_read
statement:
theorem foldMapPath_read {a b : V} (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G)
    (H := H) (V := V)) (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = a)
    (q : @Quiver.Path V _ (allArrowTarget e₀) b)
    (hq : foldPathAvoid e₀ q)
    (hread : L.pathRead q =
      (separatedMap (allArrowLabel L e₀))⁻¹) :
    ∀ {x y : V} (p : @Quiver.Path V _ x y),
      (@BinaryLabelling.pathRead G H (foldVertex a b)
        _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
        (foldLabelling L e₀)
        _ _
        (foldMapPath e₀ ha q hq p)) = L.pathRead p
proof:
:= by
  intro x y p
  induction p with
  | nil =>
      simp only [foldMapPath, BinaryLabelling.pathRead_nil]
  | cons p e ih =>
      calc
        (@BinaryLabelling.pathRead G H (foldVertex a b)
          _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
          (foldLabelling L e₀) _ _
          (foldMapPath e₀ ha q hq (p.cons e))) =
            (@BinaryLabelling.pathRead G H (foldVertex a b)
              _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
              (foldLabelling L e₀) _ _
              (foldMapPath e₀ ha q hq p)) *
              (@BinaryLabelling.pathRead G H (foldVertex a b)
                _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀) (foldLabelling L e₀)
                _ _ (foldEdgePath e₀ ha e q hq)) := by
          rw [foldMapPath]
          exact @BinaryLabelling.pathRead_comp G H (foldVertex a b)
            _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀) (foldLabelling L e₀)
            _ _ (foldMapPath e₀ ha q hq p) _
              (foldEdgePath e₀ ha e q hq)
        _ = L.pathRead p * L.pathRead e.toPath := by
          rw [ih, foldEdgePath_read L e₀ ha e q hq hread]
        _ = L.pathRead (p.cons e) := by
          rw [← L.pathRead_comp p e.toPath]
          rfl

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.foldedMarkedGraph_read
statement:
theorem foldedMarkedGraph_read {n : ℕ}
    (M : MarkedBinaryGraph (G := G) (H := H) (V := V) n)
    {a b : V} (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = a)
    (q : @Quiver.Path V _ (allArrowTarget e₀) b)
    (hq : foldPathAvoid e₀ q)
    (hread : M.labeling.pathRead q =
      (separatedMap (allArrowLabel M.labeling e₀))⁻¹) :
    (@MarkedBinaryGraph.read n G H (foldVertex a b) _ _
      (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
      (foldedMarkedGraph M e₀ ha q hq)) = M.read
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change (@BinaryLabelling.pathRead G H (foldVertex a b)
      _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
      (foldLabelling M.labeling e₀) _ _
      (foldMapPath e₀ ha q hq (M.loops i))) =
    M.labeling.pathRead (M.loops i)
  exact foldMapPath_read M.labeling e₀ ha q hq hread (M.loops i)

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.foldedMarkedGraph_isGenerating
statement:
theorem foldedMarkedGraph_isGenerating {n : ℕ}
    (M : MarkedBinaryGraph (G := G) (H := H) (V := V) n)
    {a b : V} (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = a)
    (q : @Quiver.Path V _ (allArrowTarget e₀) b)
    (hq : foldPathAvoid e₀ q)
    (hread : M.labeling.pathRead q =
      (separatedMap (allArrowLabel M.labeling e₀))⁻¹)
    (hM : M.IsGenerating) :
    (@MarkedBinaryGraph.IsGenerating n G H (foldVertex a b) _ _
      (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
      (foldedMarkedGraph M e₀ ha q hq))
proof:
:= by
  change Subgroup.closure (Set.range (@MarkedBinaryGraph.read n G H
    (foldVertex a b) _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
    (foldedMarkedGraph M e₀ ha q hq))) = ⊤
  rw [foldedMarkedGraph_read M e₀ ha q hq hread]
  exact hM

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.foldedMarkedGraphSymm_read
statement:
theorem foldedMarkedGraphSymm_read {n : ℕ}
    (M : MarkedBinaryGraph (G := G) (H := H) (V := V) n)
    {a b : V} (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = a)
    (q : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV)
      ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of V qV).obj (allArrowTarget e₀))
      ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of V qV).obj b))
    (hq : foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ q)
    (hread : M.labeling.symmPathRead q =
      (separatedMap (allArrowLabel M.labeling e₀))⁻¹) :
    (@MarkedBinaryGraph.read n G H (foldVertex a b) _ _
      (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
      (foldedMarkedGraphSymm M e₀ ha q hq)) = M.read
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change (@BinaryLabelling.pathRead G H (foldVertex a b)
      _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
      (foldLabelling M.labeling e₀) _ _
      (foldSymmMapPath e₀ ha q hq
        ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of V qV).mapPath (M.loops i)))) =
    M.labeling.pathRead (M.loops i)
  calc
    _ = M.labeling.symmPathRead
        ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of V qV).mapPath (M.loops i)) :=
      foldSymmMapPath_read M.labeling e₀ ha q hq hread
        ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of V qV).mapPath (M.loops i))
    _ = M.labeling.pathRead (M.loops i) :=
      M.labeling.symmPathRead_map_of (M.loops i)

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.foldedMarkedGraphSymm_isGenerating
statement:
theorem foldedMarkedGraphSymm_isGenerating {n : ℕ}
    (M : MarkedBinaryGraph (G := G) (H := H) (V := V) n)
    {a b : V} (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = a)
    (q : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV)
      ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of V qV).obj (allArrowTarget e₀))
      ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of V qV).obj b))
    (hq : foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ q)
    (hread : M.labeling.symmPathRead q =
      (separatedMap (allArrowLabel M.labeling e₀))⁻¹)
    (hM : M.IsGenerating) :
    (@MarkedBinaryGraph.IsGenerating n G H (foldVertex a b) _ _
      (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
      (foldedMarkedGraphSymm M e₀ ha q hq))
proof:
:= by
  change Subgroup.closure (Set.range (@MarkedBinaryGraph.read n G H
    (foldVertex a b) _ _ (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
    (foldedMarkedGraphSymm M e₀ ha q hq))) = ⊤
  rw [foldedMarkedGraphSymm_read M e₀ ha q hq hread]
  exact hM

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.foldedMarkedGraphSymm_weaklyConnected
statement:
theorem foldedMarkedGraphSymm_weaklyConnected {n : ℕ}
    (M : MarkedBinaryGraph (G := G) (H := H) (V := V) n)
    {a b : V} (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = a)
    (q : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV)
      ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of V qV).obj (allArrowTarget e₀))
      ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of V qV).obj b))
    (hq : foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ q)
    (hM : M.WeaklyConnected) :
    @MarkedBinaryGraph.WeaklyConnected n G H (foldVertex a b) _ _
      (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
      (foldedMarkedGraphSymm M e₀ ha q hq)
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  refine Quotient.inductionOn v ?_
  intro v
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := hM v
  let r := foldSymmMapPath e₀ ha q hq p
  exact ⟨@Prefunctor.mapPath (foldVertex a b) (foldQuiver e₀)
    (Symmetrify (foldVertex a b))
    (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (foldVertex a b) (foldQuiver e₀))
    (@Quiver.Symmetrify.of (foldVertex a b) (foldQuiver e₀)) _ _ r⟩

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.foldedMarkedGraph_weaklyConnected
statement:
theorem foldedMarkedGraph_weaklyConnected {n : ℕ}
    (M : MarkedBinaryGraph (G := G) (H := H) (V := V) n)
    {a b : V} (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = a)
    (q : @Quiver.Path V _ (allArrowTarget e₀) b)
    (hq : foldPathAvoid e₀ q)
    (hM : M.WeaklyConnected) :
    @MarkedBinaryGraph.WeaklyConnected n G H (foldVertex a b) _ _
      (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
      (foldedMarkedGraph M e₀ ha q hq)
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  refine Quotient.inductionOn v ?_
  intro v
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := hM v
  exact ⟨foldSymmPath e₀ ha q hq p⟩

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.foldedMarkedGraph_card_lt
statement:
theorem foldedMarkedGraph_card_lt {n : ℕ}
    (M : MarkedBinaryGraph (G := G) (H := H) (V := V) n)
    {a b : V} (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    (ha : allArrowSource e₀ = a)
    (hab : a ≠ b)
    (q : @Quiver.Path V _ (allArrowTarget e₀) b)
    (hq : foldPathAvoid e₀ q) :
    Fintype.card (foldVertex a b) < Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  exact foldQuotient_card_lt hab

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.foldSymmPathAvoid_or_occurrence
statement:
theorem foldSymmPathAvoid_or_occurrence (e₀ : AllArrow (V := V))
    {x y : Symmetrify V}
    (p : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) x y) :
    foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ p ∨ SymmEdgeOccurrence (qV := qV) e₀ p
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
      exact Or.inl (by simp [foldSymmPathAvoid])
  | cons p e ih =>
      rcases ih with hp | hocc
      · by_cases he₀ : symmAllArrow e = e₀
        · exact Or.inr ⟨_, _, p, e, Path.nil, by
            rw [← Path.comp_toPath_eq_cons]
            simp, Or.inl he₀⟩
        · by_cases her : symmAllArrow e = allArrowReverse e₀
          · exact Or.inr ⟨_, _, p, e, Path.nil, by
              rw [← Path.comp_toPath_eq_cons]
              simp, Or.inr her⟩
          · exact Or.inl (by
              simpa [foldSymmPathAvoid] using ⟨hp, he₀, her⟩)
      · rcases hocc with ⟨u, z, r, f, s, hps, hf⟩
        exact Or.inr ⟨u, z, r, f, s.comp e.toPath, by
          rw [← Path.comp_toPath_eq_cons, hps]
          simp only [Path.comp_assoc], hf⟩

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.exists_safe_or_reused_fold_data
statement:
theorem exists_safe_or_reused_fold_data
    {a b : Symmetrify V}
    (p : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) a b)
    (hp : p.length ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c : Symmetrify V,
      ∃ e : @Quiver.Hom (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) a c,
        ∃ q : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) c b,
          p = e.toPath.comp q ∧
          (foldSymmPathAvoid (symmOrientedArrow e) q ∨
              SymmEdgeOccurrence (qV := qV) (symmOrientedArrow e) q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, e, q, hpq⟩ :=
    BinaryLabelling.exists_first_edge_comp (V := V) p hp
  rcases foldSymmPathAvoid_or_occurrence (qV := qV)
      (symmOrientedArrow e) q with hq | hq
  · exact ⟨c, e, q, hpq, Or.inl hq⟩
  · exact ⟨c, e, q, hpq, Or.inr hq⟩

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.safeFoldData_of_nullPath
statement:
theorem safeFoldData_of_nullPath {a b : V}
    (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G) (H := H) (V := V))
    (p : @Quiver.Path V _ a b) (hp : L.pathRead p = 1)
    (hdecomp : ∃ (c : V) (e : a ⟶ c) (q : @Quiver.Path V _ c b),
      p = e.toPath.comp q ∧ foldPathAvoid (allArrowOf e) q) :
    ∃ (c : V) (e : a ⟶ c) (q : @Quiver.Path V _ c b),
      p = e.toPath.comp q ∧ foldPathAvoid (allArrowOf e) q ∧
        L.pathRead q =
          (separatedMap (allArrowLabel L (allArrowOf e)))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, e, q, hpq, hq⟩ := hdecomp
  refine ⟨c, e, q, hpq, hq, ?_⟩
  have hprod : L.pathRead e.toPath * L.pathRead q = 1 := by
    calc
      L.pathRead e.toPath * L.pathRead q =
          L.pathRead (e.toPath.comp q) :=
        (L.pathRead_comp e.toPath q).symm
      _ = L.pathRead p := by rw [hpq]
      _ = 1 := hp
  have hq' : L.pathRead q = (L.pathRead e.toPath)⁻¹ :=
    eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hprod
  simpa [allArrowLabel] using hq'

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.safeSymmFoldData_of_nullPath
statement:
theorem safeSymmFoldData_of_nullPath
    {a b : V}
    (L : BinaryLabelling (G := G) (H := H) (V := V))
    (p : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) a b)
    (hp : L.symmPathRead p = 1)
    (hdecomp : ∃ c : Symmetrify V,
      ∃ e : @Quiver.Hom (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) a c,
        ∃ q : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) c b,
          p = e.toPath.comp q ∧
            foldSymmPathAvoid (symmOrientedArrow e) q) :
    ∃ c : Symmetrify V,
      ∃ e : @Quiver.Hom (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) a c,
        ∃ q : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) c b,
          p = e.toPath.comp q ∧
            foldSymmPathAvoid (symmOrientedArrow e) q ∧
            L.symmPathRead q =
              (separatedMap
                (allArrowLabel L (symmOrientedArrow e)))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, e, q, hpq, hqavoid⟩ := hdecomp
  refine ⟨c, e, q, hpq, hqavoid, ?_⟩
  have hprod : L.symmPathRead e.toPath * L.symmPathRead q = 1 := by
    calc
      L.symmPathRead e.toPath * L.symmPathRead q =
          L.symmPathRead (e.toPath.comp q) :=
        (L.symmPathRead_comp e.toPath q).symm
      _ = L.symmPathRead p := by rw [hpq]
      _ = 1 := hp
  have hq' : L.symmPathRead q =
      (L.symmPathRead e.toPath)⁻¹ :=
    eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hprod
  rw [L.symmPathRead_toPath] at hq'
  simpa [symmLabel_eq_allArrowLabel_oriented] using hq'

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.exists_safe_folded_marked_graph
statement:
theorem exists_safe_folded_marked_graph {n : ℕ}
    (M : MarkedBinaryGraph (G := G) (H := H) (V := V) n)
    {a b : V} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (p : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) a b)
    (hp : M.labeling.symmPathRead p = 1)
    (hdecomp : ∃ c : Symmetrify V,
      ∃ e : @Quiver.Hom (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) a c,
        ∃ q : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) c b,
          p = e.toPath.comp q ∧
            foldSymmPathAvoid (symmOrientedArrow e) q)
    (hgen : M.IsGenerating) (hconn : M.WeaklyConnected) :
    ∃ e₀ : AllArrow (V := V),
      ∃ ha : allArrowSource e₀ = a,
        ∃ q : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV)
          ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of V qV).obj (allArrowTarget e₀))
          ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of V qV).obj b),
          ∃ hq : foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ q,
            @MarkedBinaryGraph.IsGenerating n G H (foldVertex a b) _ _
                (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
                (foldedMarkedGraphSymm M e₀ ha q hq) ∧
            @MarkedBinaryGraph.WeaklyConnected n G H (foldVertex a b) _ _
                (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
                (foldedMarkedGraphSymm M e₀ ha q hq) ∧
            Fintype.card (foldVertex a b) < Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, e, q, hpq, hqavoid, hqread⟩ :=
    safeSymmFoldData_of_nullPath (qV := qV) M.labeling p hp hdecomp
  let e₀ := symmOrientedArrow e
  have ha : allArrowSource e₀ = a := by
    simpa [e₀] using symmOrientedArrow_source e
  have hct : c =
      (@Quiver.Symmetrify.of V qV).obj (allArrowTarget e₀) := by
    simpa [e₀] using (symmOrientedArrow_target e).symm
  let q' := q.cast hct rfl
  have hqavoid' : foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ q' := by
    rw [show foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ q' ↔ foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ q by
      simpa [q'] using
        foldSymmPathAvoid_cast (e₀ := e₀) hct rfl q]
    exact hqavoid
  have hqread' : M.labeling.symmPathRead q' =
      (separatedMap (allArrowLabel M.labeling e₀))⁻¹ := by
    calc
      M.labeling.symmPathRead q' = M.labeling.symmPathRead q := by
        simpa [q'] using M.labeling.symmPathRead_cast hct rfl q
      _ = (separatedMap (allArrowLabel M.labeling e₀))⁻¹ := hqread
  refine ⟨e₀, ha, q', hqavoid', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact foldedMarkedGraphSymm_isGenerating M e₀ ha q' hqavoid' hqread' hgen
  · exact foldedMarkedGraphSymm_weaklyConnected M e₀ ha q' hqavoid' hconn
  · exact foldQuotient_card_lt hab

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.exists_safe_folded_marked_graph_of_geometrically_simple
statement:
theorem exists_safe_folded_marked_graph_of_geometrically_simple {n : ℕ}
    (M : MarkedBinaryGraph (G := G) (H := H) (V := V) n)
    {a b : V} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (p : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) a b)
    (hp : M.labeling.symmPathRead p = 1)
    (hsimple : GeometricallySimple (qV := qV) p)
    (hgen : M.IsGenerating) (hconn : M.WeaklyConnected) :
    ∃ e₀ : AllArrow (V := V),
      ∃ ha : allArrowSource e₀ = a,
        ∃ q : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV)
          ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of V qV).obj (allArrowTarget e₀))
          ((@Quiver.Symmetrify.of V qV).obj b),
          ∃ hq : foldSymmPathAvoid e₀ q,
            @MarkedBinaryGraph.IsGenerating n G H (foldVertex a b) _ _
                (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
                (foldedMarkedGraphSymm M e₀ ha q hq) ∧
            @MarkedBinaryGraph.WeaklyConnected n G H (foldVertex a b) _ _
                (foldQuiver e₀) (foldHasReverse e₀)
                (foldedMarkedGraphSymm M e₀ ha q hq) ∧
            Fintype.card (foldVertex a b) < Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  have hp_len : p.length ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hab
    exact @Path.eq_of_length_zero (Symmetrify V)
      (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V qV) a b p hzero
  obtain ⟨c, e, q, hpq⟩ :=
    BinaryLabelling.exists_first_edge_comp (V := V) p hp_len
  have hqavoid : foldSymmPathAvoid (symmOrientedArrow e) q := by
    apply foldSymmPathAvoid_of_geometricallySimple e q
    rw [← hpq]
    exact hsimple
  exact exists_safe_folded_marked_graph M hab p hp
    ⟨c, e, q, hpq, hqavoid⟩ hgen hconn

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.rank_coprod_le_add
statement:
theorem rank_coprod_le_add [Group.FG G] [Group.FG H] :
    Group.rank (G ∗ H) ≤ Group.rank G + Group.rank H
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, hScard, hS⟩ := Group.rank_spec G
  obtain ⟨T, hTcard, hT⟩ := Group.rank_spec H
  let U : Finset (G ∗ H) := S.image inl ∪ T.image inr
  have hU : Subgroup.closure (U : Set (G ∗ H)) = ⊤ := by
    dsimp [U]
    rw [Finset.coe_union]
    rw [Subgroup.closure_union]
    rw [Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_image]
    have hleftfin : Subgroup.closure ((inl : G →* G ∗ H) '' (S : Set G)) =
        MonoidHom.range (inl : G →* G ∗ H) := by
      rw [← MonoidHom.map_closure, hS, ← MonoidHom.range_eq_map]
    have hrightfin : Subgroup.closure ((inr : H →* G ∗ H) '' (T : Set H)) =
        MonoidHom.range (inr : H →* G ∗ H) := by
      rw [← MonoidHom.map_closure, hT, ← MonoidHom.range_eq_map]
    rw [hleftfin, hrightfin, range_inl_sup_range_inr]
  refine (Group.rank_le (S := U) hU).trans ?_
  change (S.image inl ∪ T.image inr).card ≤ _
  calc
    (S.image inl ∪ T.image inr).card ≤ (S.image inl).card + (T.image inr).card :=
      Finset.card_union_le (S.image inl) (T.image inr)
    _ = Group.rank G + Group.rank H := by
      rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ inl_injective,
        Finset.card_image_of_injective _ inr_injective, hScard, hTcard]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.separated_left_closure
statement:
theorem separated_left_closure {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → Sum G H)
    (hs : Subgroup.closure (Set.range (separatedMap ∘ s)) = ⊤) :
    Subgroup.closure (leftGenerators s : Set G) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmap : Subgroup.closure
      ((Monoid.Coprod.fst : G ∗ H →* G) '' Set.range (separatedMap ∘ s)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [← MonoidHom.map_closure, hs, Subgroup.map_top_of_surjective]
    exact Monoid.Coprod.fst_surjective
  apply top_unique
  intro x hx
  have hx' : x ∈ Subgroup.closure
      ((Monoid.Coprod.fst : G ∗ H →* G) '' Set.range (separatedMap ∘ s)) := by
    rw [hmap]
    trivial
  have hsubset :
      (Monoid.Coprod.fst : G ∗ H →* G) '' Set.range (separatedMap ∘ s) ⊆
        Subgroup.closure (leftGenerators s : Set G) := by
    rintro y ⟨z, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    cases h : s i with
    | inl g =>
        let i' : leftIndex s := ⟨i, ⟨g, h⟩⟩
        apply Subgroup.subset_closure
        apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
        refine ⟨i', Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        simp [leftValue, separatedMap, h, i']
    | inr h' =>
        simp [separatedMap, h]
  have hmono := Subgroup.closure_mono (G := G) hsubset
  rw [Subgroup.closure_eq] at hmono
  exact hmono hx'

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.separated_right_closure
statement:
theorem separated_right_closure {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → Sum G H)
    (hs : Subgroup.closure (Set.range (separatedMap ∘ s)) = ⊤) :
    Subgroup.closure (rightGenerators s : Set H) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmap : Subgroup.closure
      ((Monoid.Coprod.snd : G ∗ H →* H) '' Set.range (separatedMap ∘ s)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [← MonoidHom.map_closure, hs, Subgroup.map_top_of_surjective]
    exact Monoid.Coprod.snd_surjective
  apply top_unique
  intro x hx
  have hx' : x ∈ Subgroup.closure
      ((Monoid.Coprod.snd : G ∗ H →* H) '' Set.range (separatedMap ∘ s)) := by
    rw [hmap]
    trivial
  have hsubset :
      (Monoid.Coprod.snd : G ∗ H →* H) '' Set.range (separatedMap ∘ s) ⊆
        Subgroup.closure (rightGenerators s : Set H) := by
    rintro y ⟨z, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    cases h : s i with
    | inl g =>
        simp [separatedMap, h]
    | inr h' =>
        let i' : rightIndex s := ⟨i, by
          intro hleft
          rcases hleft with ⟨g', hg'⟩
          rw [h] at hg'
          cases hg'⟩
        apply Subgroup.subset_closure
        apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
        refine ⟨i', Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        simp [rightValue, separatedMap, h, i']
  have hmono := Subgroup.closure_mono (G := H) hsubset
  rw [Subgroup.closure_eq] at hmono
  exact hmono hx'

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.rank_add_le_of_separated_generators
statement:
theorem rank_add_le_of_separated_generators {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → Sum G H)
    [Group.FG G] [Group.FG H]
    (hs : Subgroup.closure (Set.range (separatedMap ∘ s)) = ⊤) :
    Group.rank G + Group.rank H ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A : Finset G := leftGenerators s
  let B : Finset H := rightGenerators s
  have hA : Subgroup.closure (A : Set G) = ⊤ := by
    simpa [A] using separated_left_closure s hs
  have hB : Subgroup.closure (B : Set H) = ⊤ := by
    simpa [B] using separated_right_closure s hs
  have hrank : Group.rank G + Group.rank H ≤ A.card + B.card :=
    Nat.add_le_add (Group.rank_le hA) (Group.rank_le hB)
  have hcardA : A.card ≤ Fintype.card (leftIndex s) := by
    dsimp [A]
    exact Finset.card_image_le
  have hcardB : B.card ≤ Fintype.card (rightIndex s) := by
    dsimp [B]
    exact Finset.card_image_le
  have hindices : Fintype.card (leftIndex s) + Fintype.card (rightIndex s) = n := by
    let p : Fin n → Prop := fun i => ∃ g : G, s i = Sum.inl g
    have hcomp := @Fintype.card_subtype_compl (Fin n) inferInstance p
      (leftIndexFintype s) (rightIndexFintype s)
    have hle := @Fintype.card_subtype_le (Fin n) inferInstance p (leftIndexFintype s)
    have hcomp' : Fintype.card (rightIndex s) = Fintype.card (Fin n) -
        Fintype.card (leftIndex s) := by
      simpa [leftIndex, rightIndex, p] using hcomp
    have hle' : Fintype.card (leftIndex s) ≤ Fintype.card (Fin n) := by
      simpa [leftIndex, p] using hle
    calc
      Fintype.card (leftIndex s) + Fintype.card (rightIndex s) =
          Fintype.card (leftIndex s) +
            (Fintype.card (Fin n) - Fintype.card (leftIndex s)) := by rw [hcomp']
      _ = Fintype.card (Fin n) := Nat.add_sub_of_le hle'
      _ = n := Fintype.card_fin n
  exact hrank.trans ((Nat.add_le_add hcardA hcardB).trans_eq hindices)

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.nielsenStep_closure_eq
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | perm e h =>
      subst y
      apply le_antisymm
      · apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
        rintro z ⟨i, rfl⟩
        refine Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨e.symm i, ?_⟩
        simp [Function.comp_apply]
      · apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
        rintro z ⟨i, rfl⟩
        refine Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨e i, ?_⟩
        simp [Function.comp_apply]
  | invert i h =>
      subst y
      apply le_antisymm
      · apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
        rintro z ⟨k, rfl⟩
        by_cases hki : k = i
        · subst k
          have hi : x i ∈ Subgroup.closure
              (Set.range (Function.update x i (x i)⁻¹)) := by
            have hi' : (x i)⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.closure
                (Set.range (Function.update x i (x i)⁻¹)) :=
              Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, by simp⟩
            simpa using (Subgroup.inv_mem _ hi')
          exact hi
        · have hk : Function.update x i (x i)⁻¹ k = x k := by
            simp [hki]
          rw [← hk]
          exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨k, rfl⟩
      · apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
        rintro z ⟨k, rfl⟩
        by_cases hki : k = i
        · subst k
          have hi : x i ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) :=
            Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, rfl⟩
          simpa using (Subgroup.inv_mem _ hi)
        · have hk : Function.update x i (x i)⁻¹ k = x k := by
            simp [hki]
          rw [hk]
          exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨k, rfl⟩
  | mulRight i j hij h =>
      subst y
      apply le_antisymm
      · apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
        rintro z ⟨k, rfl⟩
        by_cases hki : k = i
        · subst k
          have hi : x i * x j ∈ Subgroup.closure
              (Set.range (Function.update x i (x i * x j))) :=
            Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, by simp⟩
          have hj : x j ∈ Subgroup.closure
              (Set.range (Function.update x i (x i * x j))) := by
            apply Subgroup.subset_closure
            exact ⟨j, by simp [hij.symm]⟩
          simpa [mul_assoc] using
            (Subgroup.mul_mem _ hi (Subgroup.inv_mem _ hj))
        · have hk : Function.update x i (x i * x j) k = x k := by
            simp [hki]
          rw [← hk]
          exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨k, rfl⟩
      · apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
        rintro z ⟨k, rfl⟩
        by_cases hki : k = i
        · subst k
          have hi : x i ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) :=
            Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, rfl⟩
          have hj : x j ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) :=
            Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨j, rfl⟩
          simpa using Subgroup.mul_mem _ hi hj
        · have hk : Function.update x i (x i * x j) k = x k := by
            simp [hki]
          rw [hk]
          exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨k, rfl⟩

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.nielsenEquivalent_closure_eq
proof:
:= by
  induction h using Relation.ReflTransGen.trans_induction_on with
  | refl => rfl
  | single h => exact nielsenStep_closure_eq h
  | trans h₁ h₂ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.trans ih₂

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.hasSeparatedReduction_of_hasNielsenSeparatedReduction
statement:
theorem hasSeparatedReduction_of_hasNielsenSeparatedReduction
    (hred : HasNielsenSeparatedReduction (G := G) (H := H)) :
    HasSeparatedReduction (G := G) (H := H)
proof:
:= by
  intro n x hx
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hred n x hx
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  calc
    Subgroup.closure (Set.range (separatedMap ∘ s)) =
        Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) :=
      (nielsenEquivalent_closure_eq hs).symm
    _ = ⊤ := hx

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.rank_coprod_eq_add_of_separated_reduction
statement:
theorem rank_coprod_eq_add_of_separated_reduction
    [Group.FG G] [Group.FG H]
    (hred : HasSeparatedReduction (G := G) (H := H)) :
    Group.rank (G ∗ H) = Group.rank G + Group.rank H
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (rank_coprod_le_add (G := G) (H := H))
  obtain ⟨S, hScard, hS⟩ := Group.rank_spec (G ∗ H)
  let eS : (↥S) ≃ Fin (Fintype.card (↥S)) := Fintype.equivFin (↥S)
  let x : Fin (Fintype.card (↥S)) → G ∗ H := fun i => eS.symm i
  have hxrange : Set.range x = (S : Set (G ∗ H)) := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact (eS.symm i).property
    · intro hy
      let y' : S := ⟨y, hy⟩
      refine ⟨eS y', ?_⟩
      simp [x, eS, y']
  have hx : Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) = ⊤ := by
    rw [hxrange]
    exact hS
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hred (Fintype.card (↥S)) x hx
  rw [← hScard]
  simpa only [Fintype.card_coe] using
    (rank_add_le_of_separated_generators s hs)

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.rank_coprod_eq_add_of_nielsen_separated_reduction
statement:
theorem rank_coprod_eq_add_of_nielsen_separated_reduction
    [Group.FG G] [Group.FG H]
    (hred : HasNielsenSeparatedReduction (G := G) (H := H)) :
    Group.rank (G ∗ H) = Group.rank G + Group.rank H
proof:
:=
  rank_coprod_eq_add_of_separated_reduction
    (hasSeparatedReduction_of_hasNielsenSeparatedReduction hred)

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.rank_coprodI_freeGroup
statement:
theorem rank_coprodI_freeGroup {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (α : ι → Type*)
    [∀ i, Fintype (α i)] :
    Group.rank (Monoid.CoprodI (fun i => FreeGroup (α i))) =
      ∑ i, Fintype.card (α i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Group.rank_congr (coprodIFreeGroupEquiv α)]
  rw [rank_freeGroup_finite]
  simp

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.factorWordProd_append
statement:
theorem factorWordProd_append (u v : List (Sum G H)) :
    factorWordProd (u ++ v) = factorWordProd u * factorWordProd v
proof:
:= by
  induction u with
  | nil => simp [factorWordProd]
  | cons x u ih =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, factorWordProd]
      rw [ih, mul_assoc]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.factorWordProd_surjective
statement:
theorem factorWordProd_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (factorWordProd (G := G) (H := H))
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x using Monoid.Coprod.induction_on' with
  | one => exact ⟨[], rfl⟩
  | inl_mul g x ih =>
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨Sum.inl g :: u, ?_⟩
      simp [factorWordProd, separatedMap, hu]
  | inr_mul h x ih =>
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨Sum.inr h :: u, ?_⟩
      simp [factorWordProd, separatedMap, hu]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.factorWordRepresented_exists
statement:
theorem factorWordRepresented_exists (x : G ∗ H) :
    ∃ n, factorWordRepresented x n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := factorWordProd_surjective x
  exact ⟨u.length, u, rfl, hu⟩

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.factorWordLength_spec
statement:
theorem factorWordLength_spec (x : G ∗ H) :
    factorWordRepresented x (factorWordLength x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Nat.find_spec (factorWordRepresented_exists x)

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.factorWordLength_wordProd_le
statement:
theorem factorWordLength_wordProd_le (u : List (Sum G H)) :
    factorWordLength (factorWordProd u) ≤ u.length
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Nat.find_min' (factorWordRepresented_exists (factorWordProd u)) ⟨u, rfl, rfl⟩

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.factorWordLength_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem factorWordLength_one :
    factorWordLength (1 : G ∗ H) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero
  simpa [factorWordProd] using
    (factorWordLength_wordProd_le (G := G) (H := H) ([] : List (Sum G H)))

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.factorWordLength_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem factorWordLength_eq_zero_iff {x : G ∗ H} :
    factorWordLength x = 0 ↔ x = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hux⟩ := factorWordLength_spec x
    have hu0 : u = [] := by
      cases u with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons a u => simp_all
    rw [hu0] at hux
    simpa [factorWordProd] using hux.symm
  · rintro rfl
    exact factorWordLength_one

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.factorWordLength_mul_le
statement:
theorem factorWordLength_mul_le (x y : G ∗ H) :
    factorWordLength (x * y) ≤ factorWordLength x + factorWordLength y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hux⟩ := factorWordLength_spec x
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvy⟩ := factorWordLength_spec y
  have huv : factorWordRepresented (x * y) (u.length + v.length) := by
    refine ⟨u ++ v, by simp [hu, hv], ?_⟩
    rw [factorWordProd_append, hux, hvy]
  have hle := Nat.find_min' (factorWordRepresented_exists (x * y)) huv
  rw [← hu, ← hv]
  exact hle

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.factorWordLength_inl_le_one
statement:
theorem factorWordLength_inl_le_one (g : G) :
    factorWordLength (inl g : G ∗ H) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Nat.find_min' (factorWordRepresented_exists (inl g))
    ⟨[Sum.inl g], rfl, by simp [factorWordProd, separatedMap]⟩

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.factorWordLength_inr_le_one
statement:
theorem factorWordLength_inr_le_one (h : H) :
    factorWordLength (inr h : G ∗ H) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Nat.find_min' (factorWordRepresented_exists (inr h))
    ⟨[Sum.inr h], rfl, by simp [factorWordProd, separatedMap]⟩

name: MarshallHall.basisRetraction_apply_of_mem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basisRetraction_apply_of_mem {X : Type u} (Y : Set X) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ Y) :
    basisRetraction Y (FreeGroup.of x) = FreeGroup.of ⟨x, hx⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [basisRetraction, hx]

name: MarshallHall.basisRetraction_apply_of_not_mem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basisRetraction_apply_of_not_mem {X : Type u} (Y : Set X) {x : X} (hx : x ∉ Y) :
    basisRetraction Y (FreeGroup.of x) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [basisRetraction, hx]

name: MarshallHall.subsetBasisHom_apply_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subsetBasisHom_apply_of {X K : Type u} [Group K]
    (B : FreeGroupBasis X K) (Y : Set X) (y : Y) :
    subsetBasisHom B Y (FreeGroup.of y) =
      ⟨B y, Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨y, y.2, rfl⟩⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [subsetBasisHom]

name: MarshallHall.subsetBasisHom_retraction_on_closure
statement:
theorem subsetBasisHom_retraction_on_closure {X K : Type u} [Group K]
    (B : FreeGroupBasis X K) (Y : Set X) (x : generatedByBasis B Y) :
    ((subsetBasisHom B Y (basisRetraction Y (B.repr x.1))) : K) = x.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction (p := fun y _ =>
    ((subsetBasisHom B Y (basisRetraction Y (B.repr y))) : K) = y) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ x.2
  · rintro y ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    rw [B.repr_apply_coe, basisRetraction_apply_of_mem Y hz,
      subsetBasisHom_apply_of]
  · simp [basisRetraction, subsetBasisHom]
  · intro y z _ _ hy hz
    change subsetBasisHom B Y (basisRetraction Y (B.repr (y * z))) = y * z
    rw [B.repr.map_mul, (basisRetraction Y).map_mul, (subsetBasisHom B Y).map_mul]
    change (subsetBasisHom B Y (basisRetraction Y (B.repr y)) : K) *
      (subsetBasisHom B Y (basisRetraction Y (B.repr z)) : K) = y * z
    rw [hy, hz]
  · intro y _ hy
    change subsetBasisHom B Y (basisRetraction Y (B.repr y⁻¹)) = y⁻¹
    rw [B.repr.map_inv, (basisRetraction Y).map_inv, (subsetBasisHom B Y).map_inv]
    change (subsetBasisHom B Y (basisRetraction Y (B.repr y)) : K)⁻¹ = y⁻¹
    rw [hy]

name: MarshallHall.subsetBasisHom_comp_retraction
statement:
theorem subsetBasisHom_comp_retraction {X K : Type u} [Group K]
    (B : FreeGroupBasis X K) (Y : Set X) :
    (subsetBasisHom B Y).comp (subsetBasisRetraction B Y) = MonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change ((subsetBasisHom B Y (subsetBasisRetraction B Y x)) : K) = x.1
  exact subsetBasisHom_retraction_on_closure B Y x

name: MarshallHall.subsetBasisRetraction_comp_hom
statement:
theorem subsetBasisRetraction_comp_hom {X K : Type u} [Group K]
    (B : FreeGroupBasis X K) (Y : Set X) :
    (subsetBasisRetraction B Y).comp (subsetBasisHom B Y) = MonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro y
  simp [subsetBasisRetraction, subsetBasisHom, B.repr_apply_coe]

name: MarshallHall.repr_subsetBasisHom
statement:
theorem repr_subsetBasisHom {X K : Type u} [Group K]
    (B : FreeGroupBasis X K) (Y : Set X) (w : FreeGroup Y) :
    B.repr ((subsetBasisHom B Y w : generatedByBasis B Y) : K) =
      FreeGroup.map (fun y : Y => (y : X)) w
proof:
:= by
  refine FreeGroup.induction_on w ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp [subsetBasisHom]
  · intro y
    simp [subsetBasisHom, B.repr_apply_coe]
  · intro y ih
    simp [subsetBasisHom, B.repr_apply_coe, ih]
  · intro x y ihx ihy
    rw [(subsetBasisHom B Y).map_mul]
    rw [show ((subsetBasisHom B Y x * subsetBasisHom B Y y :
        generatedByBasis B Y) : K) =
        (subsetBasisHom B Y x : K) * (subsetBasisHom B Y y : K) by rfl]
    rw [B.repr.map_mul]
    calc
      _ = (FreeGroup.map (fun y : Y => (y : X)) x) *
          (FreeGroup.map (fun y : Y => (y : X)) y) := congrArg₂ (fun a b => a * b) ihx ihy
      _ = FreeGroup.map (fun y : Y => (y : X)) (x * y) :=
        (FreeGroup.map_mul (fun y : Y => (y : X)) x y).symm

name: MarshallHall.repr_subsetBasisEquiv
statement:
theorem repr_subsetBasisEquiv {X K : Type u} [Group K]
    (B : FreeGroupBasis X K) (Y : Set X) (h : generatedByBasis B Y) :
    FreeGroup.map (fun y : Y => (y : X)) (subsetBasisEquiv B Y h) = B.repr (h : K)
proof:
:= by
  have hh : subsetBasisHom B Y (subsetBasisEquiv B Y h) = h := by
    change subsetBasisHom B Y (subsetBasisRetraction B Y h) = h
    have hc := congrArg (fun f : generatedByBasis B Y →* generatedByBasis B Y => f h)
      (subsetBasisHom_comp_retraction B Y)
    simpa [MonoidHom.comp_apply] using hc
  calc
    FreeGroup.map (fun y : Y => (y : X)) (subsetBasisEquiv B Y h) =
        B.repr ((subsetBasisHom B Y (subsetBasisEquiv B Y h) : generatedByBasis B Y) : K) := by
          symm
          exact repr_subsetBasisHom B Y (subsetBasisEquiv B Y h)
    _ = B.repr (h : K) := by rw [hh]

name: MarshallHall.generatedByBasis_isFreeFactor
statement:
theorem generatedByBasis_isFreeFactor {X K : Type u} [Group K]
    (B : FreeGroupBasis X K) (Y : Set X) :
    IsFreeFactor (generatedByBasis B Y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨{
    complement := FreeGroup (Yᶜ : Set X)
    equiv := basisSubsetFreeFactorEquiv B Y
    inclusion := ?_ }⟩
  intro h
  apply B.repr.injective
  simp [basisSubsetFreeFactorEquiv, B.repr_apply_coe]
  rw [FreeGroup.map.comp]
  convert repr_subsetBasisEquiv B Y h using 1
  congr 1

name: MarshallHall.isFreeFactor_of_basis_support
statement:
theorem isFreeFactor_of_basis_support {X K : Type u} [Group K]
    (H : Subgroup K) (B : FreeGroupBasis X K) (Y : Set X)
    (hY : ∀ y : Y, B y ∈ H)
    (hH : ∀ h : H, ∃ w : FreeGroup Y,
      B.repr (h : K) = FreeGroup.map (fun y : Y => (y : X)) w) :
    IsFreeFactor H
proof:
:= by
  have hle : generatedByBasis B Y ≤ H := by
    apply (Subgroup.closure_le H).2
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact hY ⟨y, hy⟩
  have hge : H ≤ generatedByBasis B Y := by
    intro h hh
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hH ⟨h, hh⟩
    let z : generatedByBasis B Y := subsetBasisHom B Y w
    have hz : (z : K) = h := by
      apply B.repr.injective
      rw [repr_subsetBasisHom, hw]
    rw [← hz]
    exact z.property
  have heq : H = generatedByBasis B Y := le_antisymm hge hle
  simpa [heq] using generatedByBasis_isFreeFactor B Y

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.path_length_cast
statement:
theorem path_length_cast {a b a' b' : V} (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b')

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.BinaryLabelling.pathLabels_nil

@[simp] theorem pathLabels_nil {a : V} :

@[simp] theorem pathLabels_toPath {a b : V} (e : a ⟶ b) :

proof:
:= by

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.BinaryLabelling.pathLabels_eq_of_endpoint_eq
statement:
theorem pathLabels_eq_of_endpoint_eq {a b c : V} (h : b = c)
    (p : Path a b) :
    L.pathLabels (h ▸ p) = L.pathLabels p
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  rfl

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.BinaryLabelling.pathLabels_cast
statement:
theorem pathLabels_cast {a b a' b' : V} (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b')
    (p : Path a b) :

proof:
:= by

statement:
theorem pathRead_cast {a b a' b' : V} (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b')
    (p : Path a b) :
    L.pathRead (p.cast ha hb) = L.pathRead p
proof:
:= by

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.BinaryLabelling.pathRead_nil
statement:
@[simp] theorem pathRead_nil {a : V} :
    L.pathRead (Path.nil : Path a a) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [pathRead, pathLabels, factorWordProd]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.BinaryLabelling.pathRead_toPath
statement:
@[simp] theorem pathRead_toPath {a b : V} (e : a ⟶ b) :
    L.pathRead e.toPath = separatedMap (L.label e)
proof:
:= by
  simp [pathRead, pathLabels, factorWordProd, separatedMap]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.BinaryLabelling.pathLabels_comp
statement:
theorem pathLabels_comp {a b : V} (p : Path a b) :
    ∀ {c : V} (q : Path b c), L.pathLabels (p.comp q) =
      L.pathLabels p ++ L.pathLabels q
proof:
| _, Path.nil => by simp
  | _, Path.cons q e => by
      simp only [Path.comp_cons, pathLabels]
      rw [pathLabels_comp p q, List.append_assoc]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.BinaryLabelling.pathRead_comp
statement:
theorem pathRead_comp {a b : V} (p : Path a b) :
    ∀ {c : V} (q : Path b c), L.pathRead (p.comp q) =
      L.pathRead p * L.pathRead q
proof:
| _, q => by
      simp only [pathRead, pathLabels_comp, factorWordProd_append]

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.BinaryLabelling.symmPathLabels_cast
statement:
theorem symmPathLabels_cast {a b a' b' : Symmetrify V}
    (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b')
    (p : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V _) a b) :

proof:

statement:
theorem symmPathRead_cast {a b a' b' : Symmetrify V}
    (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b')
    (p : @Quiver.Path (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V _) a b) :
    L.symmPathRead (p.cast ha hb) = L.symmPathRead p

name: MarshallHall.GeneralGrushko.BinaryLabelling.symmPathLabels_nil
statement:
@[simp] theorem symmPathLabels_nil {a : Symmetrify V} :
    L.symmPathLabels
      (@Quiver.Path.nil (Symmetrify V) (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver V _) a) = []
